name: Barbier.l14b_curve
statement:
theorem l14b_curve (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ => ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))
      = curve h
proof: := rfl

name: Barbier.l14b_perimeter
statement:
theorem l14b_perimeter (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖)
      = perimeter h
proof: := rfl

name: Barbier.l14b_body
statement:
theorem l14b_body (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) = body h
proof: := rfl

name: Barbier.l14b_constWidth
statement:
theorem l14b_constWidth {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hc : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) : ConstWidthSupport h w
proof: := ⟨hs, hp, hw, hc⟩

name: Barbier.l14b_piecewise
statement:
theorem l14b_piecewise {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    PiecewiseConstWidth h w
proof: := ⟨hs, hp, hw, hS, hi⟩

name: Barbier.l14b_piecewise_iff
statement:
theorem l14b_piecewise_iff {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} : PiecewiseConstWidth h w ↔
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ Function.Periodic h (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) ∧
    (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ)) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H => ⟨H.smooth, H.periodic, H.width, H.breaks, H.integrable⟩,
   fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

name: Barbier.l14b_reuleaux
statement:
theorem l14b_reuleaux {w : ℝ} {R : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) :
    R = reuleaux w
proof: := funext fun θ => hR θ

name: Barbier.l14b_contDiff_curve
statement: theorem l14b_contDiff_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (curve h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold curve
  apply ContDiff.mul
  · apply ContDiff.add
    · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (hh.of_le (by norm_num))
    · apply ContDiff.mul
      · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (contDiff_one_deriv hh)
      · exact contDiff_const
  · apply ContDiff.cexp
    apply ContDiff.mul
    · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_id
    · exact contDiff_const

name: Barbier.l14_barbier
statement:
theorem l14_barbier {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hc : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖) = π * w ∧
    eVariationOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * w)
proof:
:= by
  have H := l14b_constWidth hs hp hw hc
  refine ⟨barbier H, ?_⟩
  rw [l14b_curve]
  have nt := eVariationOn_ne_top_of_contDiff (l14b_contDiff_curve hs)
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * π)
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal nt, ← perimeter_eq_eVariationOn hs hp hc, barbier H]

name: Barbier.l14_toPiecewise
statement:
theorem l14_toPiecewise {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hc : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ Function.Periodic h (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) ∧
    (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ)) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)
proof:
:=
  l14b_piecewise_iff.1 (l14b_constWidth hs hp hw hc).toPiecewise

name: Barbier.l14_barbier_piecewise
statement:
theorem l14_barbier_piecewise {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖) = π * w
proof:
:=
  barbier_piecewise (l14b_piecewise hs hp hw hS hi)

name: Barbier.l14_reuleaux
statement:
theorem l14_reuleaux {w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 < w) {R : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) :
    
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 R ∧ Function.Periodic R (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, R θ + R (θ + π) = w) ∧
      (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv R) θ) ∧
        (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ R θ + deriv (deriv R) θ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => R θ + deriv (deriv R) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) ∧
    
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖) = π * w ∧
    
    ¬ ContDiff ℝ 2 R ∧
    
    (let γ := fun t : ℝ =>
        ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I);
      dist (γ 0) (γ (2 * π / 3)) = w ∧ dist (γ (2 * π / 3)) (γ (4 * π / 3)) = w ∧
      dist (γ (4 * π / 3)) (γ 0) = w) ∧
    
    (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (5 * π / 6) (7 * π / 6),
      dist ((fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ)
        ((fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0) = w) ∧
    
    eVariationOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := l14b_reuleaux hR
  exact ⟨l14b_piecewise_iff.1 (reuleaux_constWidth hw0), reuleaux_perimeter hw0,
    reuleaux_not_smooth hw0, reuleaux_vertices hw0, reuleaux_arc hw0, reuleaux_length hw0⟩

name: Barbier.l14_length
statement:
theorem l14_length {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc a b) ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc a b)).toReal = ∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖
proof:
:=
  length_eq_integral_norm_deriv hγ hab

name: Barbier.l14_perimeter_eq_eVariationOn
statement:
theorem l14_perimeter_eq_eVariationOn {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hc : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ‖) =
    (eVariationOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π))).toReal ∧
    eVariationOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  ⟨perimeter_eq_eVariationOn hs hp hc,
   eVariationOn_ne_top_of_contDiff (l14b_contDiff_curve hs) (by positivity)⟩

name: Barbier.l14_body
statement:
theorem l14_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    Convex ℝ (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) ∧
    ∀ θ : ℝ,
      IsGreatest (Set.range fun φ => inner ℝ ((fun t : ℝ =>
        ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) φ)
        (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) (h θ) ∧
      (fun t : ℝ => ((h t : ℂ) + ((deriv h t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) θ ∈
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) ∧
      sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) ''
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ})) = h θ ∧
      sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) ''
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}))
      + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) ''
        (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ})) = w
proof:
:= by
  have H := l14b_piecewise hs hp hw hS hi
  exact ⟨convex_body h, fun θ => ⟨bridge_support_piecewise H θ, curve_mem_body_piecewise H θ,
    support_body_piecewise H θ, width_body_piecewise H θ⟩⟩

name: Barbier.l14_convexBody
statement:
theorem l14_convexBody {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w)
    (hS : ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ))
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) :
    IsCompact (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}) ∧
    (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ}).Nonempty ∧
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = ⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ h θ} ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = h θ) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)
proof:
:= by
  have H := l14b_piecewise hs hp hw hS hi
  exact ⟨isCompact_body_piecewise H, body_nonempty_piecewise H, exists_convexBody_piecewise H⟩

name: Barbier.l14_reuleaux_convexBody
statement:
theorem l14_reuleaux_convexBody {w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 < w) {R : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) :
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = ⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ R θ} ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := l14b_reuleaux hR
  exact reuleaux_convexBody hw0

name: Barbier.l14w_barbier
statement:
theorem l14w_barbier :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) ∧ Function.Periodic (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) (2 * π) ∧
    (∀ θ, (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) θ + (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) (θ + π) = 4) ∧
    (∀ θ, 0 ≤ (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) θ + deriv (deriv (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ))) θ) ∧
    (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) 0 ≠ (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) (π / 3) ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => (((fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℂ) + ((deriv (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ≠ (fun t : ℝ => (((fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℂ) + ((deriv (fun θ : ℝ => 2 + 1 / 4 * Real.cos (3 * θ)) t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) π ∧
    0 < π * 4
proof:
:= by
  have H : ConstWidthSupport (trefoil 2 (1 / 4)) (2 * 2) :=
    trefoil_constWidth (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hw := (bridge_constWidth H).1 0
  refine ⟨H.smooth, H.periodic, fun θ => by have := H.width θ; norm_num at this ⊢; exact this,
    H.convex, trefoil_not_const (by norm_num), ?_, by positivity⟩
  intro he
  change curve (trefoil 2 (1 / 4)) 0 = curve (trefoil 2 (1 / 4)) π at he
  rw [zero_add, he, sub_self, inner_zero_left] at hw
  norm_num at hw

name: Barbier.l14w_reuleaux
statement:
theorem l14w_reuleaux :
    ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ θ, R θ =
      if toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ ≤ π / 6 then
        (1 / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ)
      else 1 - (1 / Real.sqrt 3) *
        Real.cos (toIcoMod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3) (-(π / 6)) θ - π / 3)) ∧
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 R ∧ Function.Periodic R (2 * π) ∧ (∀ θ, R θ + R (θ + π) = 1) ∧
    (∃ S : Set ℝ, S.Countable ∧ (∀ θ ∉ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv R) θ) ∧
      (∀ θ ∉ S, 0 ≤ R θ + deriv (deriv R) θ)) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => R θ + deriv (deriv R) θ) volume 0 (2 * π)) ∧
    ¬ ContDiff ℝ 2 R ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ≠ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (2 * π / 3) ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (2 * π / 3) ≠ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (4 * π / 3) ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (4 * π / 3) ≠ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) 0 ∈ (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ R θ}) ∧ (fun t : ℝ => ((R t : ℂ) + ((deriv R t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (t * Complex.I)) (2 * π / 3) ∈ (⋂ θ : ℝ, {z : ℂ | (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re ≤ R θ}) ∧
    0 < π * 1
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) < 1 := one_pos
  obtain ⟨d1, d2, d3⟩ := reuleaux_vertices hw
  refine ⟨reuleaux 1, fun θ => rfl, l14b_piecewise_iff.1 (reuleaux_constWidth hw),
    reuleaux_not_smooth hw, ?_, ?_, ?_, curve_mem_body_piecewise (reuleaux_constWidth hw) 0,
    curve_mem_body_piecewise (reuleaux_constWidth hw) _, by positivity⟩
  · intro he; change curve _ _ = curve _ _ at he; rw [he, dist_self] at d1; exact zero_ne_one d1
  · intro he; change curve _ _ = curve _ _ at he; rw [he, dist_self] at d2; exact zero_ne_one d2
  · intro he; change curve _ _ = curve _ _ at he; rw [he, dist_self] at d3; exact zero_ne_one d3

name: Barbier.l14w_length
statement:
theorem l14w_length :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) ∧ (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 ∧
    (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) 0 ≠ (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) 1 ∧
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖deriv (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) t‖) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) t = 1 := fun t =>
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).ofReal_comp).deriv
  refine ⟨Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff, zero_le_one, by simp, ?_⟩
  simp [hd]

name: eVariationOn_eq_integral_norm_deriv
proof:
:= by
  have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℝ γ := hγ.differentiable_one
  have hγ_deriv_cont : Continuous (deriv γ) := hγ.continuous_deriv_one
  have hnorm_cont : Continuous (fun t => ‖deriv γ t‖) := hγ_deriv_cont.norm
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖deriv γ t‖) volume a b :=
    hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hint_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict hab
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))
  
  have hnn : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d → 0 ≤ ∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖ := fun c d hcd =>
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict hcd
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))
  
  have hstep : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d → ‖γ d - γ c‖ ≤ ∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖ := fun c d hcd => by
    apply norm_sub_le_integral_of_norm_deriv_le_of_le hcd
    · exact hγ.continuous.continuousOn
    · exact hγ_diff.differentiableOn.mono (subset_univ _)
    · filter_upwards with t _ using le_refl _
    · exact hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable c d
  
  have hlocal_ub : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d →
      eVariationOn γ (Icc c d) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
    intro c d hcd
    apply iSup_le
    rintro ⟨n, u, hu, us⟩
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edist (γ (u (i + 1))) (γ (u i))
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in u i..u (i + 1), ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          have hui := hu (Nat.le_succ i)
          rw [edist_le_ofReal (hnn _ _ hui), dist_eq_norm]
          exact hstep (u i) (u (i + 1)) hui
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ t in u i..u (i + 1), ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn _ _ (hu (Nat.le_succ i)))]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in u 0..u n, ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          congr 1
          apply sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
          intro k _
          exact hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable (u k) (u (k + 1))
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          apply integral_mono_interval (us 0).1 (hu (Nat.zero_le n)) (us n).2
          · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
          · exact hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable c d
  
  have hupper : eVariationOn γ (Icc a b) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖) :=
    hlocal_ub a b hab
  
  have hlocal_ub_real : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d →
      (eVariationOn γ (Icc c d)).toReal ≤ ∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖ :=
    fun c d hcd => ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (hnn c d hcd) (hlocal_ub c d hcd)
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hγ.contDiffOn.exists_lipschitzOnWith (by norm_num) (convex_Icc a b) isCompact_Icc
  have hbv : BoundedVariationOn γ (Icc a b) := by
    have := hK.locallyBoundedVariationOn a b (left_mem_Icc.mpr hab) (right_mem_Icc.mpr hab)
    rwa [inter_self] at this
  
  have hlower : ∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖ ≤ (eVariationOn γ (Icc a b)).toReal := by
    
    have hbv_at : ∀ t : ℝ, a ≤ t → t ≤ b → eVariationOn γ (Icc a t) ≠ ⊤ :=
      fun t hat htb =>
        (eVariationOn.mono γ (Icc_subset_Icc_right htb) |>.trans_lt hbv.lt_top).ne
    
    have hbv_sub : ∀ {t s : ℝ}, a ≤ t → s ≤ b → eVariationOn γ (Icc t s) ≠ ⊤ :=
      fun {t s} hat hsb =>
        (eVariationOn.mono γ (Icc_subset_Icc hat hsb) |>.trans_lt hbv.lt_top).ne
    
    let V : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (eVariationOn γ (Icc a t)).toReal
    
    have hVincr : ∀ {t s : ℝ}, a ≤ t → t ≤ s → s ≤ b →
        V s - V t = (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal := by
      intro t s hat hts hsb
      simp only [V]
      have hAt : eVariationOn γ (Icc a t) ≠ ⊤ := hbv_at t hat (hts.trans hsb)
      have hBt : eVariationOn γ (Icc t s) ≠ ⊤ := hbv_sub hat hsb
      have hadd : eVariationOn γ (Icc a t) + eVariationOn γ (Icc t s) =
          eVariationOn γ (Icc a s) := by
        rw [← univ_inter (Icc a t), ← univ_inter (Icc t s), ← univ_inter (Icc a s)]
        exact eVariationOn.Icc_add_Icc γ hat hts (mem_univ t)
      have hadd_real : (eVariationOn γ (Icc a t)).toReal + (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal =
          (eVariationOn γ (Icc a s)).toReal := by
        rw [← ENNReal.toReal_add hAt hBt, hadd]
      linarith
    
    have hVarK : ∀ {t s : ℝ}, a ≤ t → t ≤ s → s ≤ b →
        (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal ≤ K * (s - t) := by
      intro t s hat hts hsb
      have hMaps : MapsTo id (Icc t s) (Icc a b) :=
        fun x hx => ⟨hat.trans hx.1, hx.2.trans hsb⟩
      have hbound : eVariationOn γ (Icc t s) ≤ K * eVariationOn id (Icc t s) := by
        have := hK.comp_eVariationOn_le hMaps
        simpa using this
      rw [eVariationOn_id_Icc] at hbound
      have h1 : (K * ENNReal.ofReal (s - t)).toReal = K * (s - t) := by
        rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.coe_toReal, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hts)]
      rw [← h1]
      exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
        hbound
    
    have hVlip : LipschitzOnWith K V (Icc a b) := by
      apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro t ht s hs
      rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
      rcases le_total t s with hts | hst
      · 
        have hVdiff_ts : V s - V t = (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal := hVincr ht.1 hts hs.2
        have hVnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        have hVmono : V t ≤ V s := by linarith
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hVmono), neg_sub, hVdiff_ts,
            abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hts)]
        exact hVarK ht.1 hts hs.2
      · 
        have hVdiff_st : V t - V s = (eVariationOn γ (Icc s t)).toReal := hVincr hs.1 hst ht.2
        have hVnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (eVariationOn γ (Icc s t)).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        have hVmono : V s ≤ V t := by linarith
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hVmono), hVdiff_st,
            abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)]
        exact hVarK hs.1 hst ht.2
    
    have hVcont : ContinuousOn V (Icc a b) := hVlip.continuousOn
    
    have hVa : V a = 0 := by simp [V]
    
    have hVderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivWithinAt V ‖deriv γ t‖ (Ioi t) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hasDerivWithinAt_iff_isLittleO]
      
      have hFTC : HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ x in a..u, ‖deriv γ x‖) ‖deriv γ t‖ t :=
        integral_hasDerivAt_right (hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable a t)
          (hnorm_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hnorm_cont.continuousAt
      
      have hγt : HasDerivAt γ (deriv γ t) t := (hγ_diff t).hasDerivAt
      
      apply IsLittleO.of_bound
      intro ε hε
      have hFTC_bd := hFTC.isLittleO.def (half_pos hε)
      have hγ_bd := hγt.isLittleO.def (half_pos hε)
      have hsb_ev : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] t, s ≤ b := by
        apply eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht.2] with s hs using le_of_lt hs
      filter_upwards [hFTC_bd.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
                      hγ_bd.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
                      self_mem_nhdsWithin, hsb_ev] with s hFTC_s hγ_s hst hsb'
      have hst_pos : t < s := hst
      have hts_le : t ≤ s := hst_pos.le
      
      have hBne : eVariationOn γ (Icc t s) ≠ ⊤ := hbv_sub ht.1.le hsb'
      
      have hVdiff : V s - V t = (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal :=
        hVincr ht.1.le hts_le hsb'
      
      have hI_split : ∫ x in t..s, ‖deriv γ x‖ =
          (∫ x in a..s, ‖deriv γ x‖) - ∫ x in a..t, ‖deriv γ x‖ :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left
          (hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable a s) (hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable a t)).symm
      
      have hVub : (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal ≤ ∫ x in t..s, ‖deriv γ x‖ :=
        hlocal_ub_real t s hts_le
      
      have hVlb : ‖γ s - γ t‖ ≤ (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal := by
        have h := eVariationOn.edist_le γ
          (show t ∈ Icc t s from ⟨le_refl t, hts_le⟩)
          (show s ∈ Icc t s from ⟨hts_le, le_refl s⟩)
        rw [edist_dist, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at h
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hBne).mp h
      
      have key_FTC : |(∫ x in t..s, ‖deriv γ x‖) - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖| ≤ ε / 2 * ‖s - t‖ := by
        have bound := hFTC_s
        simp only [smul_eq_mul] at bound
        rw [← hI_split] at bound
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at bound
      
      have key_γ_norm : |‖γ s - γ t‖ - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖| ≤ ε / 2 * ‖s - t‖ := by
        calc |‖γ s - γ t‖ - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖|
            = |‖γ s - γ t‖ - ‖(s - t) • deriv γ t‖| := by
                congr 1; rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hts_le)]
          _ ≤ ‖(γ s - γ t) - (s - t) • deriv γ t‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le _ _
          _ = ‖γ s - γ t - (s - t) • deriv γ t‖ := rfl
          _ ≤ ε / 2 * ‖s - t‖ := hγ_s
      
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hVdiff, smul_eq_mul]
      rcases le_total ((eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal) ((s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖) with hcase | hcase
      · 
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hcase), neg_sub]
        calc (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖ - (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal
            ≤ (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖ - ‖γ s - γ t‖ := by linarith
          _ ≤ |(s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖ - ‖γ s - γ t‖| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |‖γ s - γ t‖ - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖| := abs_sub_comm _ _
          _ ≤ ε / 2 * ‖s - t‖ := key_γ_norm
          _ ≤ ε * ‖s - t‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s - t)]
      · 
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcase)]
        calc (eVariationOn γ (Icc t s)).toReal - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖
            ≤ (∫ x in t..s, ‖deriv γ x‖) - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖ := sub_le_sub_right hVub _
          _ ≤ |(∫ x in t..s, ‖deriv γ x‖) - (s - t) * ‖deriv γ t‖| := le_abs_self _
          _ ≤ ε / 2 * ‖s - t‖ := key_FTC
          _ ≤ ε * ‖s - t‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s - t)]
    
    calc ∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖
        ≤ V b - V a :=
          integral_le_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le hab hVcont hVderiv
            hnorm_cont.integrableOn_Icc (fun t _ => le_refl _)
      _ = (eVariationOn γ (Icc a b)).toReal := by simp [V, hVa]
  
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hint_nonneg hupper
  · exact hlower

name: Barbier.Classical.E_apply0
statement: lemma E_apply0 (z : ℂ) : (E z) 0 = z.re
proof: := rfl

name: Barbier.Classical.E_apply1
statement: lemma E_apply1 (z : ℂ) : (E z) 1 = z.im
proof: := rfl

name: Barbier.Classical.deriv_E_comp
statement: lemma deriv_E_comp (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) : deriv (fun s => E (γ s)) t = E (deriv γ t)
proof:
:= by
  show fderiv ℝ (E ∘ γ) t 1 = E (fderiv ℝ γ t 1)
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.comp_fderiv]; rfl

name: Barbier.Classical.curveLength_E
statement:
lemma curveLength_E (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (T : ℝ) :
    curveLength (fun s => E (γ s)) T = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..T, ‖deriv γ t‖
proof:
:= by
  unfold curveLength; congr 1; funext t; rw [deriv_E_comp, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]

name: Barbier.Classical.eVariationOn_E
statement:
lemma eVariationOn_E (f : ℝ → ℂ) (s : Set ℝ) :
    eVariationOn (fun t => E (f t)) s = eVariationOn f s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eVariationOn, LinearIsometryEquiv.edist_map]

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_supportFn_obligation
statement: theorem cov_supportFn_obligation : obl_supportFn
proof:
:= by
  intro K hK u
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := hK.1.exists_isMaxOn (hK.2.2.mono interior_subset)
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : Plane => inner ℝ x u).continuousOn)
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_, fun y hy => hmax hy⟩
  unfold supportFn
  exact IsGreatest.csSup_eq ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, by rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact hmax hy⟩

name: Barbier.Classical.isPlaneConvexBody_iInter
statement:
theorem isPlaneConvexBody_iInter {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → Plane) (w : ℝ)
    (hw : 0 < w) (hd : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ w) :
    IsPlaneConvexBody (⋂ i, Metric.closedBall (v i) w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i0⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
  refine ⟨(isCompact_closedBall (v i0) w).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_iInter fun i => Metric.isClosed_closedBall) (Set.iInter_subset _ i0),
    convex_iInter fun i => convex_closedBall _ _, ?_⟩
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  refine ⟨(1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) • ∑ j, v j, ?_⟩
  rw [interior_iInter_of_finite]
  refine Set.mem_iInter.2 fun i => interior_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall ?_
  rw [Metric.isOpen_ball.interior_eq, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
  have hid : (1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) • ∑ j, v j - v i
      = (1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) • ∑ j, (v j - v i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith), one_smul]
  have hsum : ‖∑ j, (v j - v i)‖ ≤ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * w := by
    calc ‖∑ j, (v j - v i)‖ ≤ ∑ j, ‖v j - v i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖v j - v i‖ := (Finset.sum_erase _ (by simp)).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hd j i
      _ = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * w := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ,
            nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub Fintype.card_pos]; simp
  rw [hid, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  calc 1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ‖∑ j, (v j - v i)‖
      ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * w) := by gcongr
    _ < w := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)]; nlinarith

name: Barbier.Classical.E_curve
statement:
lemma E_curve (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    E (Barbier.curve h θ) = !₂[h θ * Real.cos θ - deriv h θ * Real.sin θ,
                               h θ * Real.sin θ + deriv h θ * Real.cos θ]
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i
  · simp [E_apply0, Barbier.curve, Complex.mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  · simp [E_apply1, Barbier.curve, Complex.mul_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_a_support
statement: theorem cov_C1_a_support : classical_C1_a_support
proof:
:= by
  intro p w hC2 hper hpos hwidth
  have hcv : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ p θ + deriv (deriv p) θ := fun θ => (hpos θ).le
  have e : (fun θ => !₂[p θ * Real.cos θ - deriv p θ * Real.sin θ,
      p θ * Real.sin θ + deriv p θ * Real.cos θ]) = fun θ => E (Barbier.curve p θ) :=
    funext fun θ => (E_curve p θ).symm
  rw [e, curveLength_E]
  exact ⟨perimeter_eq_integral hC2 hper hcv, integral_support_eq hC2.continuous hwidth⟩

name: Barbier.Classical.supportFn_E_body
statement:
lemma supportFn_E_body (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    supportFn (E '' body h) (E (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) = h θ
proof:
:= by
  unfold supportFn
  rw [Set.image_image]
  have : (fun z => inner ℝ (E z) (E (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)))) =
      fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re := by
    funext z; rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map, bridge_inner_exp, neg_mul]
  rw [this]; exact support_body_piecewise H θ

name: Barbier.Classical.unit_eq_E_exp
statement:
lemma unit_eq_E_exp (u : Plane) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    u = E (Complex.exp ((Complex.arg (E.symm u) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖E.symm u‖ = 1 := by rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, hu]
  have := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (E.symm u)
  rw [h1, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul] at this
  rw [this, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Barbier.Classical.hasConstantWidth_E_body
statement:
lemma hasConstantWidth_E_body (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    HasConstantWidth (E '' body h) w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hw, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨θ, rfl⟩ : ∃ θ : ℝ, u = E (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) := ⟨_, unit_eq_E_exp u hu⟩
  have hneg : -E (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) =
      E (Complex.exp (((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    rw [← map_neg]; congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [add_mul, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I]; ring
  unfold widthIn
  rw [hneg, supportFn_E_body H, supportFn_E_body H]
  exact H.width θ

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_b_part
statement:
theorem cov_C1_b_part (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    IsCompact (E '' body h) ∧ Convex ℝ (E '' body h) ∧ HasConstantWidth (E '' body h) w ∧
      Barbier.perimeter h = π * w
proof:
:=
  ⟨(isCompact_body_piecewise H).image E.continuous,
    (convex_body h).linear_image E.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap,
    hasConstantWidth_E_body H hw, barbier_piecewise H⟩

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_a_part
statement:
theorem cov_C1_a_part (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    curveLength (fun θ => E (Barbier.curve h θ)) (2 * π) = π * w ∧
      eVariationOn (fun θ => E (Barbier.curve h θ)) (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * w) ∧
      HasConstantWidth (E '' body h) w
proof:
:= by
  have hc1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (Barbier.curve h) := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun θ => ((h θ : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (H.smooth.of_le (by norm_num))
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun θ => ((deriv h θ : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (contDiff_one_deriv H.smooth)
    have c3 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun θ : ℝ => ((θ : ℝ) : ℂ)) := Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff
    unfold Barbier.curve
    exact (h1.add (h2.mul contDiff_const)).mul (c3.mul contDiff_const).cexp
  have hL := length_eq_integral_norm_deriv hc1 (a := 0) (b := 2 * π) Real.two_pi_pos.le
  refine ⟨by rw [curveLength_E]; exact barbier H, ?_, hasConstantWidth_E_body H.toPiecewise hw⟩
  rw [eVariationOn_E, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hL.1, hL.2]
  congr 1; exact barbier H

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C1_b_equiv_part
statement:
theorem cov_C1_b_equiv_part (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (hw : 0 < w) :
    Barbier.perimeter h = Barbier.perimeter (fun _ => w / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [barbier_piecewise H, circle_perimeter w hw.le]

name: Barbier.Classical.reuleauxTriangle_eq
statement:
lemma reuleauxTriangle_eq (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) :
    reuleauxTriangle A B C w = ⋂ i : Fin 3, Metric.closedBall (![A, B, C] i) w
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [reuleauxTriangle, Fin.forall_fin_succ, and_assoc]

name: Barbier.Classical.isPlaneConvexBody_reuleaux
statement:
theorem isPlaneConvexBody_reuleaux (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    IsPlaneConvexBody (reuleauxTriangle A B C w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reuleauxTriangle_eq]
  apply isPlaneConvexBody_iInter _ w hw
  have hBA : dist B A = w := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hAB
  have hCB : dist C B = w := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hBC
  have hAC : dist A C = w := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hCA
  intro i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hAB, hBC, hCA, hBA, hCB, hAC, hw.le]

name: Barbier.Classical.vertex_near_center
statement:
lemma vertex_near_center {R : Set Plane} {X c : Plane} {r w : ℝ} (hR : R = Metric.closedBall c r)
    (hX : X ∈ R) (hsub : R ⊆ Metric.closedBall X w) : dist c X ≤ w / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hXr : dist c X ≤ r := by
    rw [hR, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm] at hX; exact hX
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist c X) with h0 | hX0
  · rw [← h0]
    have : X ∈ Metric.closedBall X w := hsub hX
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self] at this; linarith
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hX0 hXr ⊢
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hXr
  set x : Plane := c + (r / ‖c - X‖) • (c - X)
  have hxD : x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
    simp only [x, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hX0.ne']
  have hxX : dist x X = ‖c - X‖ + r := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have : x - X = (1 + r / ‖c - X‖) • (c - X) := by
      simp only [x, add_smul, one_smul]; abel
    rw [this, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), add_mul, one_mul,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ hX0.ne']
  rw [← hR] at hxD
  have := hsub hxD
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hxX] at this
  linarith

name: Barbier.Classical.reuleaux_not_disk
statement:
theorem reuleaux_not_disk (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    ¬ ∃ (c : Plane) (r : ℝ), reuleauxTriangle A B C w = Metric.closedBall c r
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, r, hR⟩
  have hAC : dist A C = w := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hCA
  have hBA : dist B A = w := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hAB
  have hCB : dist C B = w := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hBC
  have memA : A ∈ reuleauxTriangle A B C w :=
    ⟨⟨by simp [hw.le], by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hAB]⟩, by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hAC]⟩
  have memB : B ∈ reuleauxTriangle A B C w :=
    ⟨⟨by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hBA], by simp [hw.le]⟩, by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hBC]⟩
  have memC : C ∈ reuleauxTriangle A B C w :=
    ⟨⟨by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hCA], by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hCB]⟩, by simp [hw.le]⟩
  have sA : reuleauxTriangle A B C w ⊆ Metric.closedBall A w := fun x hx => hx.1.1
  have sB : reuleauxTriangle A B C w ⊆ Metric.closedBall B w := fun x hx => hx.1.2
  have sC : reuleauxTriangle A B C w ⊆ Metric.closedBall C w := fun x hx => hx.2
  have a := vertex_near_center hR memA sA
  have b := vertex_near_center hR memB sB
  have g := vertex_near_center hR memC sC
  have ap1 := dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq c A B
  have ap2 := dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq C A B
  have tri := dist_triangle C c (midpoint ℝ A B)
  rw [hAB] at ap1 ap2
  rw [hCA, hCB] at ap2
  have h0 := dist_nonneg (x := c) (y := A)
  have h1 := dist_nonneg (x := c) (y := B)
  have h2 := dist_nonneg (x := c) (y := midpoint ℝ A B)
  have h3 := dist_nonneg (x := c) (y := C)
  have hm : dist c (midpoint ℝ A B) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hm0 : dist c (midpoint ℝ A B) = 0 := by nlinarith
  rw [hm0, add_zero, dist_comm C c] at tri
  have hCm : dist C (midpoint ℝ A B) ≤ w / 2 := le_trans tri g
  have hCm0 := dist_nonneg (x := C) (y := midpoint ℝ A B)
  have : dist C (midpoint ℝ A B) ^ 2 ≤ (w / 2) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hCm0 hCm 2
  nlinarith

proof:

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C2_b_part
statement:
theorem cov_C2_b_part (hw : 0 < w) :
    let γ : ℝ → Plane := fun θ => E (Barbier.curve (reuleaux w) θ)
    dist (γ 0) (γ (2 * π / 3)) = w ∧ dist (γ (2 * π / 3)) (γ (4 * π / 3)) = w ∧
      dist (γ (4 * π / 3)) (γ 0) = w ∧
      (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (5 * π / 6) (7 * π / 6), dist (γ θ) (γ 0) = w) ∧
      eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) = ENNReal.ofReal (3 * (w * (π / 3))) ∧
      eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * w) ∧
      IsCompact (E '' body (reuleaux w)) ∧ Convex ℝ (E '' body (reuleaux w)) ∧
      HasConstantWidth (E '' body (reuleaux w)) w
proof:
:= by
  intro γ
  obtain ⟨v1, v2, v3⟩ := reuleaux_vertices hw
  have hb := cov_C1_b_part (reuleaux_constWidth hw) hw
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, fun θ hθ => ?_, ?_, ?_, hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2.1⟩
  · simp only [γ, LinearIsometryEquiv.dist_map]; exact v1
  · simp only [γ, LinearIsometryEquiv.dist_map]; exact v2
  · simp only [γ, LinearIsometryEquiv.dist_map]; exact v3
  · simp only [γ, LinearIsometryEquiv.dist_map]; exact reuleaux_arc hw θ hθ
  · simp only [γ]; rw [eVariationOn_E, reuleaux_length hw]; congr 1; ring
  · simp only [γ]; rw [eVariationOn_E, reuleaux_length hw]

name: Barbier.Classical.angle_equilateral
statement:
lemma angle_equilateral (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) :
    EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = π / 3
proof:
:= by
  have hl := EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_sub_two_mul_dist_mul_dist_mul_cos_angle B A C
  rw [dist_comm B A, hAB, hCA, hBC] at hl
  have hc : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) = Real.cos (π / 3) := by
    rw [Real.cos_pi_div_three]
    have : w * w * (2 * Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) - 1) = 0 := by nlinarith
    have hww : w * w ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have := (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left hww
    linarith
  exact Real.injOn_cos ⟨EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg _ _ _, EuclideanGeometry.angle_le_pi _ _ _⟩
    ⟨by positivity, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩ hc

name: Barbier.Classical.cov_C2_boundary_part
statement:
theorem cov_C2_boundary_part (A B C : Plane) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hAB : dist A B = w) (hBC : dist B C = w) (hCA : dist C A = w) :
    EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = π / 3 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle C B A = π / 3 ∧
      EuclideanGeometry.angle A C B = π / 3
proof:
:=
  ⟨angle_equilateral A B C w hw hAB hCA hBC,
   angle_equilateral B C A w hw hBC hAB hCA,
   angle_equilateral C A B w hw hCA hBC hAB⟩

name: Barbier.eVariationOn_ne_top_of_contDiff
proof:
:= by
  have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℝ γ := hγ.differentiable_one
  have hγ_deriv_cont : Continuous (deriv γ) := hγ.continuous_deriv_one
  have hnorm_cont : Continuous (fun t => ‖deriv γ t‖) := hγ_deriv_cont.norm
  have hnn : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d → 0 ≤ ∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖ := fun c d hcd =>
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict hcd
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))
  have hstep : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d → ‖γ d - γ c‖ ≤ ∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖ := fun c d hcd => by
    apply norm_sub_le_integral_of_norm_deriv_le_of_le hcd
    · exact hγ.continuous.continuousOn
    · exact hγ_diff.differentiableOn.mono (subset_univ _)
    · filter_upwards with t _ using le_refl _
    · exact hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable c d
  have hlocal_ub : ∀ c d : ℝ, c ≤ d →
      eVariationOn γ (Icc c d) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
    intro c d hcd
    apply iSup_le
    rintro ⟨n, u, hu, us⟩
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edist (γ (u (i + 1))) (γ (u i))
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in u i..u (i + 1), ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          have hui := hu (Nat.le_succ i)
          rw [edist_le_ofReal (hnn _ _ hui), dist_eq_norm]
          exact hstep (u i) (u (i + 1)) hui
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ t in u i..u (i + 1), ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn _ _ (hu (Nat.le_succ i)))]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in u 0..u n, ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          congr 1
          apply sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
          intro k _
          exact hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable (u k) (u (k + 1))
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in c..d, ‖deriv γ t‖) := by
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          apply integral_mono_interval (us 0).1 (hu (Nat.zero_le n)) (us n).2
          · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
          · exact hnorm_cont.intervalIntegrable c d
  have hupper : eVariationOn γ (Icc a b) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖) :=
    hlocal_ub a b hab
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hupper

name: Barbier.length_eq_integral_norm_deriv
statement:
theorem length_eq_integral_norm_deriv {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : ContDiff ℝ 1 γ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc a b) ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (eVariationOn γ (Set.Icc a b)).toReal = ∫ t in a..b, ‖deriv γ t‖
proof:
:=
  ⟨eVariationOn_ne_top_of_contDiff hγ hab,
   eVariationOn_eq_integral_norm_deriv hγ hab⟩

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_curve_pointwise
proof:
:= by
  have d0 : HasDerivAt h (deriv h theta) theta := (h1.differentiable one_ne_zero theta).hasDerivAt
  have d1 : HasDerivAt (deriv h) (deriv (deriv h) theta) theta := hd.hasDerivAt
  have de : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      (Complex.exp ((theta : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (1 * Complex.I)) theta :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id theta).ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I).cexp
  have := ((d0.ofReal_comp).add ((d1.ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I)).mul de
