name: Barbier.ConstWidthSupport.toPiecewise
statement: theorem ConstWidthSupport.toPiecewise (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) : PiecewiseConstWidth h w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨H.smooth.of_le (by norm_num), H.periodic, H.width,
          ⟨∅, Set.countable_empty, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro θ _
    exact H.smooth.differentiable_deriv_two θ
  · 
    intro θ _
    exact H.convex θ
  · 
    have hdd : Continuous (fun θ => deriv (deriv h) θ) :=
      (contDiff_one_deriv H.smooth).continuous_deriv_one
    exact (H.smooth.continuous.add hdd).intervalIntegrable _ _

name: Barbier.barbier_piecewise
statement: theorem barbier_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : perimeter h = π * w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS_count, hS_diff, hS_conv⟩ := H.breaks
  
  have h_intdd : IntervalIntegrable (fun theta => deriv (deriv h) theta) volume 0 (2 * π) := by
    have := H.integrable.sub (H.smooth.continuous.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * π))
    simpa using this
  
  have h_dd_zero : ∫ theta in (0:ℝ)..(2 * π), deriv (deriv h) theta = 0 := by
    rw [integral_eq_of_hasDerivAt_off_countable_of_le (deriv h) (fun theta => deriv (deriv h) theta)
          (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hS_count
          (H.smooth.continuous_deriv_one.continuousOn.mono (Set.subset_univ _))
          (fun x ⟨_, hxS⟩ => (hS_diff x hxS).hasDerivAt) h_intdd]
    have hperiod : deriv h (2 * π) = deriv h 0 := by
      rw [show (2 : ℝ) * π = 0 + 2 * π from by ring, ← deriv_comp_add_const]
      exact congrArg (fun f => deriv f 0) (funext H.periodic)
    linarith
  
  have h_norm_ae : ∀ᵐ theta ∂volume, theta ∈ Set.uIoc 0 (2 * π) →
      ‖deriv (curve h) theta‖ = h theta + deriv (deriv h) theta := by
    filter_upwards [hS_count.ae_notMem volume] with theta hthS _
    rw [(hasDerivAt_curve_pointwise H.smooth theta (hS_diff theta hthS)).deriv,
        norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one, mul_one]
    exact abs_of_nonneg (hS_conv theta hthS)
  
  unfold perimeter
  rw [integral_congr_ae h_norm_ae,
      integral_add (H.smooth.continuous.intervalIntegrable _ _) h_intdd,
      h_dd_zero, add_zero,
      integral_support_eq H.smooth.continuous H.width]

name: Barbier.integral_support_eq
statement:
theorem integral_support_eq {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hc : Continuous h)
    (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) :
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), h θ = π * w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IntervalIntegrable h volume 0 π := hc.intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h2 : IntervalIntegrable h volume π (2 * π) := hc.intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [← integral_add_adjacent_intervals h1 h2]
  have h3 : ∫ θ in π..(2 * π), h θ = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, h (θ + π) := by
    rw [integral_comp_add_right]; congr 1 <;> ring
  have h5 : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => h (θ + π)) volume 0 π :=
    (hc.comp (continuous_add_const π)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h4 : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..π, (h θ + h (θ + π)) = π * w := by
    simp only [hw, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [integral_add h1 h5] at h4
  rw [h3, h4]

name: Barbier.contDiff_one_deriv
statement: lemma contDiff_one_deriv {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv h)
proof:
:=
  ContDiff.deriv' (by simpa [one_add_one_eq_two] using hh)

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_curve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (curve h) (((h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) θ
proof:
:= by
  have d0 : HasDerivAt h (deriv h θ) θ :=
    ((hh.differentiable (by norm_num)) θ).hasDerivAt
  have d1 : HasDerivAt (deriv h) (deriv (deriv h) θ) θ :=
    (hh.differentiable_deriv_two θ).hasDerivAt
  have de : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (1 * Complex.I)) θ :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id θ).ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I).cexp
  have := ((d0.ofReal_comp).add ((d1.ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I)).mul de
  have hI : Complex.I * Complex.I = -1 := Complex.I_mul_I
  refine this.congr_deriv ?_
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (((deriv h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * hI

name: Barbier.deriv_curve
statement:
theorem deriv_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (curve h) θ = ((h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_curve hh θ).deriv

name: Barbier.norm_deriv_curve
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (curve h) θ‖ = |h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ|
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_curve hh, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  ring

name: Barbier.norm_deriv_curve_of_convex
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_curve_of_convex {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hcv : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (curve h) θ‖ = h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_deriv_curve hh, abs_of_nonneg (hcv θ)]

name: Barbier.integral_deriv_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_deriv_deriv_eq_zero {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) :
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), deriv (deriv h) θ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := contDiff_one_deriv hh
  rw [integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun x _ => hh.differentiable_deriv_two x)
    (h1.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  have : deriv h (0 + 2 * π) = deriv h 0 := by
    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const]
    exact congrArg (fun f => deriv f 0) (funext hp)
  rw [zero_add] at this
  rw [this, sub_self]

name: Barbier.perimeter_eq_integral
statement:
theorem perimeter_eq_integral {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hcv : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    perimeter h = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * π), h θ
proof:
:= by
  unfold perimeter
  simp_rw [norm_deriv_curve_of_convex hh hcv]
  rw [integral_add (hh.continuous.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    ((contDiff_one_deriv hh).continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable _ _),
    integral_deriv_deriv_eq_zero hh hp, add_zero]

name: Barbier.barbier
statement:
theorem barbier {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) :
    perimeter h = π * w
proof:
:= by
  rw [perimeter_eq_integral H.smooth H.periodic H.convex,
    integral_support_eq H.smooth.continuous H.width]

name: Barbier.curve_proj
statement:
theorem curve_proj (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (curve h θ * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re = h θ
proof:
:= by
  unfold curve
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
  simp

name: Barbier.curve_width
statement:
theorem curve_width {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hw : ∀ θ, h θ + h (θ + π) = w) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((curve h θ - curve h (θ + π)) * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re = w
proof:
:= by
  have e : Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I)) = -Complex.exp (-(((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    push_cast
    rw [add_mul, neg_add, Complex.exp_add, ← neg_mul, Complex.exp_neg (π * Complex.I),
      Complex.exp_pi_mul_I]
    ring
  rw [sub_mul, Complex.sub_re, curve_proj, e, mul_neg, Complex.neg_re, curve_proj, sub_neg_eq_add]
  exact hw θ

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_proj_curve_at
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_proj_curve_at (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    {φ : ℝ} (hdiffφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv h) φ) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun ψ => (curve h ψ * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re)
      ((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ) * Real.sin (θ - φ)) φ
proof:
:= by
  have d0 : HasDerivAt h (deriv h φ) φ :=
    ((hh.differentiable (by norm_num)) φ).hasDerivAt
  have d1 : HasDerivAt (deriv h) (deriv (deriv h) φ) φ := hdiffφ.hasDerivAt
  have de : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (1 * Complex.I)) φ :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id φ).ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I).cexp
  have hcurve : HasDerivAt (curve h)
      (((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (φ * Complex.I))) φ := by
    have hmul := ((d0.ofReal_comp).add ((d1.ofReal_comp).mul_const Complex.I)).mul de
    refine hmul.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    push_cast
    have hI : Complex.I * Complex.I = -1 := Complex.I_mul_I
    linear_combination (((deriv h φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * hI
  have hg := hcurve.mul_const (Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I)))
  have hr := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt φ hg
  refine hr.congr_deriv ?_
  have key : ((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (φ * Complex.I))
      * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))
      = ((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.I * Complex.exp ((φ - θ : ℝ) * Complex.I)) := by
    push_cast
    rw [show (φ - θ : ℂ) * Complex.I = φ * Complex.I + -(θ * Complex.I) by ring,
      Complex.exp_add]; ring
  simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply]
  rw [key, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.I_mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
    show θ - φ = -(φ - θ) by ring, Real.sin_neg]

name: Barbier.continuous_proj_curve
statement:
private lemma continuous_proj_curve (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => (curve h φ * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re)
proof:
:= by
  unfold curve; fun_prop

name: Barbier.periodic_proj_curve
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  simp only [curve]
  have hdp : Function.Periodic (deriv h) (2 * π) := by
    intro x; rw [← deriv_comp_add_const]
    exact congrArg (fun F => deriv F x) (funext hp)
  rw [hp φ, hdp φ]; congr 2; push_cast
  rw [show (φ + 2 * π : ℂ) * Complex.I = φ * Complex.I + 2 * π * Complex.I by ring,
    Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]

name: Barbier.deriv_deriv_h_periodic
statement:
private lemma deriv_deriv_h_periodic (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) :
    Function.Periodic (deriv (deriv h)) (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  have hdp : Function.Periodic (deriv h) (2 * π) := by
    intro x; rw [← deriv_comp_add_const]
    exact congrArg (fun F => deriv F x) (funext hp)
  intro x; rw [← deriv_comp_add_const]
  exact congrArg (fun F => deriv F x) (funext hdp)

name: Barbier.sum_hdd_periodic
statement:
private lemma sum_hdd_periodic (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) :
    Function.Periodic (fun φ => h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ) (2 * π)
proof:
:= fun φ => by
  show h (φ + 2 * π) + deriv (deriv h) (φ + 2 * π) = h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ
  rw [hp φ, deriv_deriv_h_periodic hp φ]

name: Barbier.intervalIntegrable_g
statement:
private lemma intervalIntegrable_g (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun φ => (h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ) * Real.sin (θ - φ)) volume a b
proof:
:= by
  apply IntervalIntegrable.mul_continuousOn
  · 
    exact (sum_hdd_periodic H.periodic).intervalIntegrable₀
      (by linarith [Real.two_pi_pos]) H.integrable a b
  · exact (Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn.mono
        (Set.subset_univ _)

name: Barbier.bridge_support_piecewise
statement:
theorem bridge_support_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun φ => inner ℝ (curve h φ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) (h θ)
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun φ => (curve h φ * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re with hfdef
  have hfi : ∀ φ, inner ℝ (curve h φ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = f φ :=
    fun φ => bridge_inner_exp _ _
  have hfθ : f θ = h θ := curve_proj h θ
  have hfcont : Continuous f := continuous_proj_curve H.smooth θ
  have hfper : Function.Periodic f (2 * π) := periodic_proj_curve H.smooth H.periodic θ
  obtain ⟨S, hSct, hSdiff, hSconv⟩ := H.breaks
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun φ => (h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ) * Real.sin (θ - φ)
  have hder : ∀ φ ∉ S, HasDerivAt f (g φ) φ :=
    fun φ hφS => hasDerivAt_proj_curve_at H.smooth (hSdiff φ hφS) θ
  have hSae : ∀ᵐ (φ : ℝ) ∂volume, φ ∉ S := hSct.ae_notMem volume
  
  have hftc : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → ∫ φ in a..b, g φ = f b - f a := by
    intro a b hab
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_eq_of_hasDerivAt_off_countable_of_le f g hab hSct
      (hfcont.continuousOn.mono (Set.subset_univ _))
      (fun φ hφ => hder φ hφ.2)
      (intervalIntegrable_g H θ a b)
  
  have hmono : ∀ y : ℝ, θ - π ≤ y → y ≤ θ → f y ≤ f θ := by
    intro y hy1 hy2
    have hftcy := hftc y θ hy2
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ φ in y..θ, g φ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict hy2
      apply (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).mpr
      filter_upwards [hSae] with φ hφS hφ
      exact mul_nonneg (hSconv φ hφS)
        (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith [hφ.2]) (by linarith [hφ.1, hy1]))
    linarith
  
  have hanti : ∀ y : ℝ, θ ≤ y → y ≤ θ + π → f y ≤ f θ := by
    intro y hy1 hy2
    have hftcy := hftc θ y hy1
    have hnp : ∫ φ in θ..y, g φ ≤ 0 := by
      apply neg_nonneg.mp; rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict hy1
      apply (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).mpr
      filter_upwards [hSae] with φ hφS hφ
      
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, neg_nonneg]
      apply mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hSconv φ hφS)
      have hsin : 0 ≤ Real.sin (φ - θ) :=
        Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith [hφ.1]) (by linarith [hφ.2, hy2])
      have hsinθφ : Real.sin (θ - φ) = -Real.sin (φ - θ) := by
        rw [show θ - φ = -(φ - θ) by ring, Real.sin_neg]
      linarith
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨⟨θ, by simp only [hfi θ, hfθ]⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨φ, rfl⟩
  simp only [hfi φ, ← hfθ]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩ := hfper.exists_mem_Ico Real.two_pi_pos φ (θ - π)
  rw [hfy]
  rcases le_total y θ with hyθ | hyθ
  · exact hmono y hy.1 hyθ
  · exact hanti y hyθ (by linarith [hy.2, Real.pi_pos])

name: Barbier.curve_mem_body_piecewise
statement:
theorem curve_mem_body_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    curve h θ ∈ body h
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.mem_iInter.2 fun φ => ?_
  have := (bridge_support_piecewise H φ).2 ⟨θ, rfl⟩
  simp only [bridge_inner_exp] at this
  simpa [neg_mul] using this

name: Barbier.support_body_piecewise
statement:
theorem support_body_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' body h) = h θ
proof:
:= by
  refine IsGreatest.csSup_eq ⟨⟨curve h θ, curve_mem_body_piecewise H θ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa [neg_mul] using curve_proj h θ
  · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iInter.1 hz θ

name: Barbier.width_body_piecewise
statement:
theorem width_body_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' body h)
      + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' body h) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_body_piecewise H θ, support_body_piecewise H (θ + π)]
  exact H.width θ

name: Barbier.bridge_inner_exp
statement:
theorem bridge_inner_exp (z : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ z (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = (z * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.inner, ← Complex.conj_re, map_mul, Complex.conj_conj, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_mul,
    Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I, mul_comm, show (θ : ℂ) * -Complex.I = -(θ * Complex.I) by ring]

name: Barbier.bridge_curve
statement:
theorem bridge_curve {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) (θ : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (curve h θ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = h θ ∧
    inner ℝ (deriv (curve h) θ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [bridge_inner_exp, curve_proj], ?_⟩
  rw [bridge_inner_exp, deriv_curve hh, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add,
    add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.I_re, mul_zero]

name: Barbier.bridge_support
statement:
theorem bridge_support {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun φ => inner ℝ (curve h φ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) (h θ)
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun φ => (curve h φ * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))).re with hf
  have hfi : (fun φ => inner ℝ (curve h φ) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I))) = f := by
    funext φ; rw [bridge_inner_exp]
  rw [hfi]
  have hfθ : f θ = h θ := curve_proj h θ
  
  have hd : ∀ φ, HasDerivAt f ((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ) * Real.sin (θ - φ)) φ := by
    intro φ
    have hg := (hasDerivAt_curve H.smooth φ).mul_const (Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I)))
    have hr := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt φ hg
    refine hr.congr_deriv ?_
    have key : ((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (φ * Complex.I))
        * Complex.exp (-(θ * Complex.I))
        = ((h φ + deriv (deriv h) φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (((φ - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
      rw [show (((φ - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = φ * Complex.I + -(θ * Complex.I) by push_cast; ring,
        Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply]
    rw [key, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.I_mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
      show θ - φ = -(φ - θ) by ring, Real.sin_neg]
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f Set.univ := fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hmono : MonotoneOn f (Set.Icc (θ - π) θ) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _) (hcont.mono (Set.subset_univ _))
      (fun x _ => (hd x).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [interior_Icc] at hx
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sin (θ - x) :=
      Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith [hx.2]) (by linarith [hx.1])
    exact mul_nonneg (H.convex x) hs
  have hanti : AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc θ (θ + π)) := by
    refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc _ _) (hcont.mono (Set.subset_univ _))
      (fun x _ => (hd x).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [interior_Icc] at hx
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sin (x - θ) :=
      Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith [hx.1]) (by linarith [hx.2])
    rw [show θ - x = -(x - θ) by ring, Real.sin_neg]
    have := H.convex x
    nlinarith
  
  have hdp : Function.Periodic (deriv h) (2 * π) := by
    intro x
    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const]
    exact congrArg (fun F => deriv F x) (funext H.periodic)
  have hper : Function.Periodic f (2 * π) := by
    intro x
    simp only [hf, curve, H.periodic x, hdp x]
    congr 3
    rw [show (((x + 2 * π : ℝ)) : ℂ) * Complex.I = x * Complex.I + 2 * π * Complex.I by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
  refine ⟨⟨θ, hfθ⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨φ, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩ := hper.exists_mem_Ico Real.two_pi_pos φ (θ - π)
  rw [hfy, ← hfθ]
  rcases le_total y θ with hyθ | hyθ
  · exact hmono ⟨hy.1, hyθ⟩ ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], le_rfl⟩ hyθ
  · exact hanti ⟨le_rfl, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩ ⟨hyθ, by linarith [hy.2]⟩ hyθ

name: Barbier.bridge_constWidth
statement:
theorem bridge_constWidth {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) :
    (∀ θ : ℝ, inner ℝ (curve h θ - curve h (θ + π)) (Complex.exp (θ * Complex.I)) = w) ∧
    (∀ θ, ‖deriv (curve h) θ‖ = h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) ∧ 0 ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun θ => by rw [bridge_inner_exp]; exact curve_width H.width θ,
    norm_deriv_curve_of_convex H.smooth H.convex, ?_⟩
  have hp : 0 ≤ perimeter h :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
  rw [barbier H] at hp
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right (by linarith) Real.pi_pos

name: Barbier.bridge_perimeter
statement:
theorem bridge_perimeter (r : ℝ) :
    curve (fun _ => r) = circleMap 0 r ∧ perimeter (fun _ => r) = 2 * π * |r|
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨funext fun θ => by simp [curve, circleMap], ?_⟩
  unfold perimeter
  simp_rw [norm_deriv_curve (contDiff_const (c := r))]
  simp

name: Barbier.bridge_trefoil
statement:
theorem bridge_trefoil (a b θ : ℝ) :
    trefoil a b θ + trefoil a b (θ + π) = 2 * a ∧
    trefoil a b θ + deriv (deriv (trefoil a b)) θ = a - 8 * b * Real.cos (3 * θ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold trefoil
    rw [show 3 * (θ + π) = 3 * θ + π + 2 * π by ring, Real.cos_add_two_pi, Real.cos_add_pi]
    ring
  · rw [deriv_deriv_trefoil]; unfold trefoil; ring

name: Barbier.eVariationOn_eq_integral_norm_deriv
proof:
:=
  _root_.eVariationOn_eq_integral_norm_deriv hγ hab

name: Barbier.contDiff_curve_of_contDiff2
statement:
private lemma contDiff_curve_of_contDiff2 {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (curve h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold curve
  apply ContDiff.mul
  · apply ContDiff.add
    · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (hh.of_le (by norm_num))
    · apply ContDiff.mul
      · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (contDiff_one_deriv hh)
      · exact contDiff_const
  · apply ContDiff.cexp
    apply ContDiff.mul
    · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_id
    · exact contDiff_const

name: Barbier.perimeter_eq_eVariationOn
statement:
theorem perimeter_eq_eVariationOn {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ 2 h)
    (hp : Function.Periodic h (2 * π)) (hcv : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ) :
    perimeter h = (eVariationOn (curve h) (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  unfold perimeter
  rw [eVariationOn_eq_integral_norm_deriv (contDiff_curve_of_contDiff2 hh) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]

name: Barbier.convex_body
statement: theorem convex_body (h : ℝ → ℝ) : Convex ℝ (body h)
proof:
:= by
  refine convex_iInter fun θ => convex_halfSpace_le ?_ (h θ)
  refine ⟨fun x y => by simp [add_mul], fun r x => ?_⟩
  simp [Complex.real_smul, mul_assoc]

name: Barbier.curve_mem_body
statement:
theorem curve_mem_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    curve h θ ∈ body h
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.mem_iInter.2 fun φ => ?_
  have := (bridge_support H φ).2 ⟨θ, rfl⟩
  simp only [bridge_inner_exp] at this
  simpa [neg_mul] using this

name: Barbier.support_body
statement:
theorem support_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' body h) = h θ
proof:
:= by
  refine IsGreatest.csSup_eq ⟨⟨curve h θ, curve_mem_body H θ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa [neg_mul] using curve_proj h θ
  · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iInter.1 hz θ

name: Barbier.width_body
statement:
theorem width_body {h : ℝ → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (H : ConstWidthSupport h w) (θ : ℝ) :
    sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' body h)
      + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' body h) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_body H θ, support_body H (θ + π)]
  exact H.width θ

name: Barbier.isClosed_body
statement: private lemma isClosed_body (h : ℝ → ℝ) : IsClosed (body h)
proof:
:= by
  apply isClosed_iInter; intro θ
  apply isClosed_le <;> fun_prop

name: Barbier.mul_exp_neg_arg
statement:
private lemma mul_exp_neg_arg (z : ℂ) :
    z * Complex.exp (-(Complex.arg z : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ↑‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Complex.exp ((Complex.arg z : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hne
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  norm_num

name: Barbier.re_mul_exp_neg_arg
statement:
private lemma re_mul_exp_neg_arg (z : ℂ) :
    (z * Complex.exp (-(Complex.arg z : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re = ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_exp_neg_arg]; simp

name: Barbier.norm_le_of_mem_body
statement: private lemma norm_le_of_mem_body {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ body h) : ‖z‖ ≤ h (Complex.arg z)
proof:
:= by
  have hθ : (z * Complex.exp (-(↑(Complex.arg z) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re ≤ h (Complex.arg z) :=
    Set.mem_iInter.mp hz (Complex.arg z)
  linarith [re_mul_exp_neg_arg z]

name: Barbier.exists_bound_h
statement: private lemma exists_bound_h (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ θ : ℝ, h θ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_max⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * π))
      ⟨0, by constructor <;> [linarith; linarith [Real.two_pi_pos]]⟩
      H.smooth.continuous.continuousOn
  refine ⟨h x, fun θ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩ := H.periodic.exists_mem_Ico₀ Real.two_pi_pos θ
  rw [hfy]
  exact hx_max ⟨by linarith [hy.1], by linarith [hy.2, Real.pi_pos]⟩

name: Barbier.isBounded_body
statement: private lemma isBounded_body (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : Bornology.IsBounded (body h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_bound_h H
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0]
  exact ⟨M, fun z hz => by
    simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact (norm_le_of_mem_body hz).trans (hM _)⟩

name: Barbier.isCompact_body_piecewise
statement: theorem isCompact_body_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : IsCompact (body h)
proof:
:=
  Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded (isClosed_body h) (isBounded_body H)

name: Barbier.body_nonempty_piecewise
statement: theorem body_nonempty_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) : (body h).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨curve h 0, curve_mem_body_piecewise H 0⟩

name: Barbier.exists_convexBody_piecewise
statement:
theorem exists_convexBody_piecewise (H : PiecewiseConstWidth h w) :
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = body h ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = h θ) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨body h, convex_body h, isCompact_body_piecewise H, body_nonempty_piecewise H⟩,
    ConvexBody.coe_mk _ _ _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro θ; simp only [ConvexBody.coe_mk]; exact support_body_piecewise H θ
  · intro θ; simp only [ConvexBody.coe_mk]; exact width_body_piecewise H θ

name: Barbier.reuleaux_convexBody
statement:
theorem reuleaux_convexBody {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    ∃ K : ConvexBody ℂ, (K : Set ℂ) = body (reuleaux w) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-θ * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ))
        + sSup ((fun z => (z * Complex.exp (-((θ + π : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re) '' (K : Set ℂ)) = w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, _, hwidth⟩ := exists_convexBody_piecewise (reuleaux_constWidth hw)
  exact ⟨K, hK, hwidth⟩

name: Barbier.reuleaux_period_pos
statement: lemma reuleaux_period_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π / 3
proof: := by positivity

name: Barbier.toIcoMod_zero
statement:
private lemma toIcoMod_zero :
    toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]
  exact ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], by
    show (0 : ℝ) < -(π/6) + 2*π/3; linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩

name: Barbier.toIcoMod_two_pi_div_three
statement:
private lemma toIcoMod_two_pi_div_three :
    toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) (2 * π / 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (2 * π / 3 : ℝ) = 0 + (1 : ℤ) • (2 * π / 3) := by simp
  calc toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) (2 * π / 3)
      = toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) (0 + (1 : ℤ) • (2 * π / 3)) := by rw [← h]
    _ = toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) 0 := toIcoMod_add_zsmul _ _ _ _
    _ = 0 := toIcoMod_zero

name: Barbier.toIcoMod_four_pi_div_three
statement:
private lemma toIcoMod_four_pi_div_three :
    toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) (4 * π / 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (4 * π / 3 : ℝ) = 0 + (2 : ℤ) • (2 * π / 3) := by push_cast; ring
  calc toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) (4 * π / 3)
      = toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) (0 + (2 : ℤ) • (2 * π / 3)) := by rw [← h]
    _ = toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) 0 := toIcoMod_add_zsmul _ _ _ _
    _ = 0 := toIcoMod_zero

name: Barbier.pi_div6_pos
statement: private lemma pi_div6_pos : (0 : ℝ) < π / 6
proof: := by positivity

name: Barbier.pi6_neg_lt_pi6
statement: private lemma pi6_neg_lt_pi6 : -(Real.pi / 6) < Real.pi / 6
proof: := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]

name: Barbier.pi6_lt_pi2
statement: private lemma pi6_lt_pi2 : Real.pi / 6 < Real.pi / 2
proof: := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_val_zero
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_val_zero {p : ℝ} (hp : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π/6)) p = 0) (w : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w p = w / Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hp, if_pos (le_of_lt pi_div6_pos)]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_zero
statement: private lemma reuleaux_zero (w : ℝ) : reuleaux w 0 = w / Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:=
  reuleaux_val_zero toIcoMod_zero w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_two_pi_div_three
statement: private lemma reuleaux_two_pi_div_three (w : ℝ) : reuleaux w (2 * π / 3) = w / Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:=
  reuleaux_val_zero toIcoMod_two_pi_div_three w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_four_pi_div_three
statement: private lemma reuleaux_four_pi_div_three (w : ℝ) : reuleaux w (4 * π / 3) = w / Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:=
  reuleaux_val_zero toIcoMod_four_pi_div_three w

name: Barbier.reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_zero
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_zero (w : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w =ᶠ[nhds 0] (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith [pi_div6_pos] : -(π/6) < 0) pi_div6_pos)
  intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  unfold reuleaux reuleauxPiece
  have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π/6)) θ = θ := by
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]
    exact ⟨le_of_lt hlo, by show θ < -(π/6) + 2*π/3; linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩
  rw [hmod, if_pos (le_of_lt hhi)]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_two_pi_div_three
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_two_pi_div_three (w : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w =ᶠ[nhds (2*π/3)] (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - 2*π/3))
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith [pi_div6_pos] : 2*π/3 - π/6 < 2*π/3)
                  (by linarith [pi_div6_pos] : 2*π/3 < 2*π/3 + π/6))
  intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  unfold reuleaux reuleauxPiece
  have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π/6)) θ = θ - 2*π/3 := by
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by show θ - 2*π/3 < -(π/6) + 2*π/3; linarith⟩,
           1, by push_cast; ring⟩
  rw [hmod, if_pos (by linarith)]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_four_pi_div_three
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_four_pi_div_three (w : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w =ᶠ[nhds (4*π/3)] (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - 4*π/3))
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith [pi_div6_pos] : 4*π/3 - π/6 < 4*π/3)
                  (by linarith [pi_div6_pos] : 4*π/3 < 4*π/3 + π/6))
  intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  unfold reuleaux reuleauxPiece
  have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π/6)) θ = θ - 4*π/3 := by
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by show θ - 4*π/3 < -(π/6) + 2*π/3; linarith⟩,
           2, by push_cast; ring⟩
  rw [hmod, if_pos (by linarith)]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
  intro θ ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
  unfold reuleaux reuleauxPiece
  have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi/6)) θ = θ := by
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]
    exact ⟨le_of_lt hlo', by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩
  rw [hmod, if_pos (le_of_lt hhi')]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_locally_eq_arc_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
  intro θ ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
  unfold reuleaux reuleauxPiece
  have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi/6)) θ = θ := by
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩
  rw [hmod, if_neg (not_le.mpr hlo')]

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_cos_sub
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_cos_sub (k θ₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.cos (θ - k)) (-Real.sin (θ₀ - k)) θ₀
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ - k) (1 - 0) θ₀ :=
    (hasDerivAt_id θ₀).sub (hasDerivAt_const θ₀ k)
  have h1' : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ - k) 1 θ₀ := h1.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (θ₀ - k)).comp θ₀ h1'
  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: Barbier.deriv_reuleaux_zero
statement: private lemma deriv_reuleaux_zero (w : ℝ) : deriv (reuleaux w) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_zero w).deriv_eq]
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos θ)
      (w / Real.sqrt 3 * (-Real.sin 0)) 0 :=
    ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).const_mul _)
  rw [hd.deriv, Real.sin_zero, neg_zero, mul_zero]

name: Barbier.deriv_reuleaux_two_pi_div_three
statement: private lemma deriv_reuleaux_two_pi_div_three (w : ℝ) : deriv (reuleaux w) (2 * π / 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_two_pi_div_three w).deriv_eq]
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (θ - 2 * π / 3))
      (w / Real.sqrt 3 * (-Real.sin (2 * π / 3 - 2 * π / 3))) (2 * π / 3) :=
    (hasDerivAt_cos_sub (2*π/3) (2*π/3)).const_mul _
  rw [hd.deriv, show 2*π/3 - 2*π/3 = (0:ℝ) from by ring, Real.sin_zero, neg_zero, mul_zero]

name: Barbier.deriv_reuleaux_four_pi_div_three
statement: private lemma deriv_reuleaux_four_pi_div_three (w : ℝ) : deriv (reuleaux w) (4 * π / 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_four_pi_div_three w).deriv_eq]
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (θ - 4 * π / 3))
      (w / Real.sqrt 3 * (-Real.sin (4 * π / 3 - 4 * π / 3))) (4 * π / 3) :=
    (hasDerivAt_cos_sub (4*π/3) (4*π/3)).const_mul _
  rw [hd.deriv, show 4*π/3 - 4*π/3 = (0:ℝ) from by ring, Real.sin_zero, neg_zero, mul_zero]

name: Barbier.curve_reuleaux_zero
statement:
private lemma curve_reuleaux_zero (w : ℝ) :
    curve (reuleaux w) 0 = ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [curve, reuleaux_zero, deriv_reuleaux_zero]

name: Barbier.curve_reuleaux_two_pi_div_three
proof:
:= by
  simp only [curve, reuleaux_two_pi_div_three, deriv_reuleaux_two_pi_div_three]
  push_cast; ring

name: Barbier.curve_reuleaux_four_pi_div_three
proof:
:= by
  simp only [curve, reuleaux_four_pi_div_three, deriv_reuleaux_four_pi_div_three]
  push_cast; ring

name: Barbier.sqrt3_sq
statement: private lemma sqrt3_sq : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3
proof: := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)

name: Barbier.sqrt3_pos
statement: private lemma sqrt3_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt 3
proof: := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)

name: Barbier.sqrt3_ne_zero
statement: private lemma sqrt3_ne_zero : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0
proof: := ne_of_gt sqrt3_pos

name: Barbier.normSq_exp_sub_one
statement:
private lemma normSq_exp_sub_one (θ : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq (Complex.exp (↑θ * Complex.I) - 1) = 2 - 2 * Real.cos θ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Complex.exp (↑θ * Complex.I) - 1 =
      ↑(Real.cos θ - 1) + ↑(Real.sin θ) * Complex.I := by
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
    push_cast; ring
  rw [heq, Complex.normSq_add_mul_I]
  nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]

name: Barbier.normSq_exp_two_pi3_sub_one
statement:
private lemma normSq_exp_two_pi3_sub_one :
    Complex.normSq (Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) - 1) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [normSq_exp_sub_one]
  have : Real.cos (2 * π / 3) = -1/2 := by
    rw [show 2*π/3 = π - π/3 from by ring, Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_three]; norm_num
  linarith

name: Barbier.normSq_exp_four_pi3_sub_one
statement:
private lemma normSq_exp_four_pi3_sub_one :
    Complex.normSq (Complex.exp (↑(4 * π / 3) * Complex.I) - 1) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [normSq_exp_sub_one]
  have : Real.cos (4 * π / 3) = -1/2 := by
    rw [show 4*π/3 = 2*π - 2*π/3 from by ring, Real.cos_two_pi_sub,
        show 2*π/3 = π - π/3 from by ring, Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_three]; norm_num
  linarith

name: Barbier.norm_eq_of_normSq
statement:
private lemma norm_eq_of_normSq {z : ℂ} {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (h : Complex.normSq z = w ^ 2) :
    ‖z‖ = w
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hsq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = w ^ 2 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at h; linarith
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖z‖ - w)]

name: Barbier.dist_reuleaux_0_2pi3
statement:
private lemma dist_reuleaux_0_2pi3 {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) 0) (curve (reuleaux w) (2 * π / 3)) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_reuleaux_zero, curve_reuleaux_two_pi_div_three, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [show ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) -
        ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * (Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) - 1) by push_cast; ring]
  apply norm_eq_of_normSq hw
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_ofReal, normSq_exp_two_pi3_sub_one]
  field_simp; nlinarith [sqrt3_sq]

name: Barbier.dist_reuleaux_2pi3_4pi3
statement:
private lemma dist_reuleaux_2pi3_4pi3 {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) (2 * π / 3)) (curve (reuleaux w) (4 * π / 3)) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_reuleaux_two_pi_div_three, curve_reuleaux_four_pi_div_three, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [show ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) -
        ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(4 * π / 3) * Complex.I) =
      ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) *
        (1 - Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I)) by
    have : Complex.exp (↑(4 * π / 3) * Complex.I) =
        Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]; push_cast; ring_nf
    rw [this]; push_cast; ring]
  apply norm_eq_of_normSq hw
  have hnsq_exp : Complex.normSq (Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I)) = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_pow]
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_ofReal, hnsq_exp, mul_one,
      show (1 : ℂ) - Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) =
          -(Complex.exp (↑(2 * π / 3) * Complex.I) - 1) from by ring,
      Complex.normSq_neg, normSq_exp_two_pi3_sub_one]
  field_simp; nlinarith [sqrt3_sq]

name: Barbier.dist_reuleaux_4pi3_0
statement:
private lemma dist_reuleaux_4pi3_0 {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) (4 * π / 3)) (curve (reuleaux w) 0) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_reuleaux_zero, curve_reuleaux_four_pi_div_three, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [show ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(4 * π / 3) * Complex.I) -
        ((w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * (Complex.exp (↑(4 * π / 3) * Complex.I) - 1) by push_cast; ring]
  apply norm_eq_of_normSq hw
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_ofReal, normSq_exp_four_pi3_sub_one]
  field_simp; nlinarith [sqrt3_sq]

name: Barbier.dderiv_left
proof:
:= by
  have hd1eq : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[nhds θ₀] (fun θ => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin θ) := by
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
    intro θ ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
    rw [(reuleaux_locally_eq_cos_of_mem hlo' hhi' w).deriv_eq]
    rw [(((Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3))).deriv]; ring
  rw [hd1eq.deriv_eq]
  rw [((Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ₀).const_mul (-(w / Real.sqrt 3))).deriv]

name: Barbier.dderiv_right
proof:
:= by
  have hd1eq : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[nhds θ₀]
      (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ - Real.pi / 3)) := by
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
    intro θ ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
    rw [(reuleaux_locally_eq_arc_of_mem hlo' hhi' w).deriv_eq]
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w - w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 3))
        (w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sin (θ - Real.pi / 3)) θ :=
      ((hasDerivAt_const θ w).sub ((hasDerivAt_cos_sub (Real.pi/3) θ).const_mul
        (w / Real.sqrt 3))).congr_deriv (by ring)
    rw [hd.deriv]
  rw [hd1eq.deriv_eq]
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ - Real.pi / 3) 1 θ₀ :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id θ₀).sub (hasDerivAt_const θ₀ _)).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (θ₀ - Real.pi/3)).comp θ₀ h1
  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one] at h2
  rw [(h2.const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)).deriv]

name: Barbier.Ioo_mem_nhdsGT'
statement: private lemma Ioo_mem_nhdsGT' {a b : ℝ} (h : a < b) : Ioo a b ∈ 𝓝[>] a
proof:
:= by
  rw [(nhdsGT_basis_of_exists_gt ⟨b, h⟩).mem_iff]
  exact ⟨b, h, Subset.rfl⟩

name: Barbier.one_le_sqrt_three'
statement: private lemma one_le_sqrt_three' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 from Real.sqrt_one.symm]
  exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by norm_num)

name: Barbier.sqrt_three_pos'
statement: private lemma sqrt_three_pos' : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 3
proof: := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)

name: Barbier.w_div_sqrt3_le_w
statement: private lemma w_div_sqrt3_le_w (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) : w / Real.sqrt 3 ≤ w
proof:
:=
  div_le_self hw.le one_le_sqrt_three'

name: Barbier.reuleaux_le_w
statement: private lemma reuleaux_le_w (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) (θ : ℝ) : reuleaux w θ ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece]
  split_ifs with h
  · calc (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ)
        ≤ w / Real.sqrt 3 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.cos_le_one _) (by positivity)
      _ = w / Real.sqrt 3 := mul_one _
      _ ≤ w := w_div_sqrt3_le_w w hw
  · push_neg at h
    have hcos_nn : 0 ≤ Real.cos (toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ - Real.pi / 3) := by
      apply Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
      have hrange := toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
      constructor <;> linarith [hrange.1, hrange.2, Real.pi_pos]
    linarith [mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hw.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg 3)) hcos_nn]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_nonneg'
statement: private lemma reuleaux_nonneg' (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) (θ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ reuleaux w θ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece]
  split_ifs with h
  · apply mul_nonneg; · positivity
    · apply Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
      have hrange := toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
      constructor <;> linarith [hrange.1, hrange.2, Real.pi_pos]
  · push_neg at h
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    have hrange := toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    have hcos_nn : 0 ≤ Real.cos (toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ - Real.pi / 3) := by
      apply Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc; constructor <;> linarith [hrange.1, hrange.2, Real.pi_pos]
    calc w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ - Real.pi / 3)
        ≤ w / Real.sqrt 3 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.cos_le_one _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ w := by rw [mul_one]; exact w_div_sqrt3_le_w w hw

name: Barbier.toIcoMod_two_pi_eq'
proof:
:= by
  have heq : θ + 2 * Real.pi = θ + (3 : ℤ) • (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring
  rw [heq, toIcoMod_add_zsmul]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_periodic
statement: lemma reuleaux_periodic (w : ℝ) : Function.Periodic (reuleaux w) (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= fun θ => by
  simp only [reuleaux, toIcoMod_two_pi_eq']

name: Barbier.toIcoMod_k_int'
statement:
private lemma toIcoMod_k_int' (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k,
         by simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: Barbier.reuleaux_width
statement: lemma reuleaux_width (w : ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : reuleaux w θ + reuleaux w (θ + Real.pi) = w
proof:
:= by
  
  have hp_range : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ ∈
      Set.Ico (-(Real.pi / 6)) (-(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3) :=
    toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
  set p := toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ with hp_def
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, θ = p + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    use toIcoDiv reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    have h := toIcoMod_add_toIcoDiv_zsmul reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul] at h; linarith
  have hpθ : p = θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by rw [hk]; ring
  have hhi_θ : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    rw [hk]; linarith [hp_range.2, show -(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 2 from by ring]
  
  
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hp_range.1 with hlo_eq | hlo_lt
  · 
    have hp_eq : p = -(Real.pi / 6) := hlo_eq.symm
    
    have hmod_θ : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = -(Real.pi / 6) :=
      hp_def.symm.trans hp_eq
    have hval_θ : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (-(Real.pi / 6)) := by
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod_θ]; rw [if_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]
    
    have hmod_θpi : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (θ + Real.pi) =
        Real.pi / 6 := by
      rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k + 1,
             by push_cast; rw [hk, hp_eq]; ring⟩
    have hval_θpi : reuleaux w (θ + Real.pi) = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6) := by
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod_θpi]
      rw [if_pos le_rfl]
    rw [hval_θ, hval_θpi]
    have h3 : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num)
    have hsq : Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sqrt 3 = 3 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
    simp only [Real.cos_neg, Real.cos_pi_div_six]
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  · 
    have hlo_θ : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ := by rw [hk]; linarith
    have hmod_θ := toIcoMod_k_int' k θ hlo_θ hhi_θ
    rcases lt_trichotomy p (Real.pi / 6) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · 
      have hval_θ : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos p := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece]; rw [if_pos (le_of_lt hlt)]
      have hk1 : ((k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_cast
      have hmod_θpi : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (θ + Real.pi) =
          θ + Real.pi - (k + 1 : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) :=
        toIcoMod_k_int' (k + 1) (θ + Real.pi) (by rw [hk1, hk]; linarith [Real.pi_pos])
          (by rw [hk1, hk]; linarith [Real.pi_pos])
      have hval_θpi : reuleaux w (θ + Real.pi) =
          w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ + Real.pi - (k + 1 : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod_θpi]
        rw [if_neg (by rw [hk1, hk]; linarith [Real.pi_pos])]
      rw [hval_θ, hval_θpi, hk1, hpθ]; push_cast; ring
    · 
      have hmod_θ_eq : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = Real.pi / 6 :=
        hmod_θ.trans (hpθ.symm.trans heq)
      have hval_θ : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod_θ_eq]; rw [if_pos le_rfl]
      have hmod_θpi : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (θ + Real.pi) = -(Real.pi / 6) := by
        rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
        exact ⟨⟨le_refl _, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k + 2,
               by push_cast; rw [hk, heq]; ring⟩
      have hval_θpi : reuleaux w (θ + Real.pi) = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (-(Real.pi / 6)) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod_θpi]
        rw [if_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]
      rw [hval_θ, hval_θpi]
      have h3 : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num)
      have hsq : Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sqrt 3 = 3 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
      simp only [Real.cos_pi_div_six, Real.cos_neg]
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    · 
      have hval_θ : reuleaux w θ = w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (p - Real.pi / 3) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece]; rw [if_neg (by linarith)]
      have hk2 : ((k + 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) + 2 := by norm_cast
      have hmod_θpi : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (θ + Real.pi) =
          θ + Real.pi - (k + 2 : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) :=
        toIcoMod_k_int' (k + 2) (θ + Real.pi) (by rw [hk2, hk]; linarith)
          (by rw [hk2, hk]; linarith)
      have hval_θpi : reuleaux w (θ + Real.pi) =
          (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ + Real.pi - (k + 2 : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod_θpi]; rw [if_pos (by rw [hk2, hk]; linarith)]
      rw [hval_θ, hval_θpi, hk2, hpθ]; push_cast; ring

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_cos_sub_kk'
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_cos_sub_kk' (c θ₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.cos (θ - c)) (-Real.sin (θ₀ - c)) θ₀
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ - c) 1 θ₀ :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id θ₀).sub (hasDerivAt_const θ₀ c)).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (θ₀ - c)).comp θ₀ h1
  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one] at h2; exact h2

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_sin_sub_kk'
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_sin_sub_kk' (c θ₀ : ℝ) :

proof:

  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one] at h2; exact h2

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_cos_fn''
proof:
:=
  ((hasDerivAt_cos_sub_kk' ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) θ₀).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)).congr_deriv (by ring)

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_arc_fn''
proof:
:= by
  have hd := ((hasDerivAt_const θ₀ w).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_cos_sub_kk' ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3) θ₀).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)))
  have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w - w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (θ - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3)))
      (w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sin (θ₀ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) θ₀ :=
    hd.congr_deriv (by
      rw [show θ₀ - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3) =
          θ₀ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3 from by ring]; ring)
  rwa [show (fun θ => w - w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (θ - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3))) =
            (fun θ => w - w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) from by
    ext θ; congr 2; ring] at hd'

name: Barbier.deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq''
statement:
private lemma deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    deriv (reuleaux w) θ = -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
proof:
:= by
  apply HasDerivAt.deriv
  apply (hasDerivAt_cos_fn'' w k θ).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  apply eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
  intro θ' hθ'
  obtain ⟨hloθ', hhiθ'⟩ := hθ'
  have hmod := toIcoMod_k_int' k θ' hloθ' (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_pos (by linarith)]

name: Barbier.deriv_reuleaux_arc_eq''
statement:
private lemma deriv_reuleaux_arc_eq'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    deriv (reuleaux w) θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)
proof:
:= by

  apply (hasDerivAt_arc_fn'' w k θ).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  apply eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
  intro θ' hθ'
  obtain ⟨hloθ', hhiθ'⟩ := hθ'
  have hmod := toIcoMod_k_int' k θ' (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])

name: Barbier.differentiableAt_deriv_reuleaux_cos''
statement:
private lemma differentiableAt_deriv_reuleaux_cos'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[nhds θ]
      (fun θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) :=
    eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi) fun θ' hθ' =>
      deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq'' w k θ' hθ'.1 hθ'.2
  exact hlocal.differentiableAt_iff.mpr (by fun_prop)

name: Barbier.differentiableAt_deriv_reuleaux_arc''
statement:
private lemma differentiableAt_deriv_reuleaux_arc'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[nhds θ]
      (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) :=
    eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi) fun θ' hθ' =>

name: Barbier.dderiv_reuleaux_cos''
statement:
private lemma dderiv_reuleaux_cos'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ = -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[nhds θ]
      (fun θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) :=
    eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi) fun θ' hθ' =>
      deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq'' w k θ' hθ'.1 hθ'.2
  rw [hlocal.deriv_eq]
  exact ((hasDerivAt_sin_sub_kk' ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) θ).const_mul
    (-(w / Real.sqrt 3))).congr_deriv (by ring) |>.deriv

name: Barbier.dderiv_reuleaux_arc''
statement:
private lemma dderiv_reuleaux_arc'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[nhds θ]
      (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) :=
    eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi) fun θ' hθ' =>
      deriv_reuleaux_arc_eq'' w k θ' hθ'.1 hθ'.2
  rw [hlocal.deriv_eq]
  
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3))
      ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) θ := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3)))
        ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3))) θ :=
      ((hasDerivAt_sin_sub_kk' ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3) θ).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3))
    rwa [show (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3))) =
              (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) from by
          ext θ''; congr 2; ring,
         show θ - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + Real.pi / 3) =
              θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3 from by ring] at h1
  exact hd.deriv

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_reuleaux_pi6
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_reuleaux_pi6 (w : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (reuleaux w) (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (Real.pi / 6)
proof:
:= by
  have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ)
      (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (Real.pi / 6) :=
    ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos _).const_mul _).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hd_arc : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 3))
      (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (Real.pi / 6) := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ - Real.pi / 3) 1 (Real.pi / 6) :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id _).sub (hasDerivAt_const _ _)).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos _).comp _ h1
    have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_const _ w).sub (h2.const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)))
    exact h3.congr_deriv (by
      simp only [mul_one, neg_mul]
      rw [show Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi / 3 = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring)
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_left_right]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (hd_cos.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsLT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi / 6))
    intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ := by
      rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hmod6 : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (Real.pi / 6) = Real.pi / 6 := by
      rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hθ : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ := by
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_pos (le_of_lt hhi)]
    have h6 : reuleaux w (Real.pi / 6) = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6) := by
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod6]; rw [if_pos le_rfl]
    simp only [slope, hθ, h6]
  · apply (hd_arc.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : Real.pi / 6 < Real.pi / 2))
    intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ := by
      rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hmod6 : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (Real.pi / 6) = Real.pi / 6 := by
      rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hθ : reuleaux w θ = w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 3) := by
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hlo)]
    have h6 : reuleaux w (Real.pi / 6) = w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi / 3) := by
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod6]; rw [if_pos le_rfl]
      rw [show Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi / 3 = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.cos_neg, Real.cos_pi_div_six]
      have h : Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sqrt 3 = 3 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
      field_simp; nlinarith
    simp only [slope, hθ, h6]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_periodic_third
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_periodic_third (w : ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w (θ + 2 * Real.pi / 3) = reuleaux w θ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reuleaux]
  congr 1
  have heq : θ + 2 * Real.pi / 3 = θ + (1 : ℤ) • (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    simp [zsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [heq]
  exact toIcoMod_add_zsmul reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ 1

name: Barbier.reuleaux_period_shift
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_period_shift (w : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w (t + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) = reuleaux w t
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    push_cast at ih ⊢
    rw [show t + (↑k + 1) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) = t + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + 2 * Real.pi / 3 from by ring]
    rw [reuleaux_periodic_third]; exact ih
  | pred k ih =>
    push_cast at ih ⊢
    rw [show t + (-↑k - 1) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) = t + -↑k * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - 2 * Real.pi / 3 from by ring]
    have : reuleaux w (t + -↑k * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - 2 * Real.pi / 3 + 2 * Real.pi / 3) =
        reuleaux w (t + -↑k * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - 2 * Real.pi / 3) :=
      reuleaux_periodic_third w _
    rw [show t + -↑k * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - 2 * Real.pi / 3 + 2 * Real.pi / 3 =
        t + -↑k * (2 * Real.pi / 3) from by ring] at this
    rw [← this]; exact ih

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_reuleaux_kbreak
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : ∀ t, reuleaux w t = reuleaux w (t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) := fun t => by
    have h := reuleaux_period_shift w k (t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
    rwa [show t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) = t from by ring] at h
  have hfunEq : reuleaux w =ᶠ[𝓝 (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))]
      (fun t => reuleaux w (t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfun
  apply hfunEq.hasDerivAt_iff.mpr
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) 1
      (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id _).sub (hasDerivAt_const _ _)).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hpi6 : HasDerivAt (reuleaux w) (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6))
      ((fun t => t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) := by
    simp only [show Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) =
        Real.pi / 6 from by ring]
    exact hasDerivAt_reuleaux_pi6 w
  exact (hpi6.comp (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) h1).congr_deriv (mul_one _)

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_reuleaux_neg_pi6_kbreak
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfun : ∀ t, reuleaux w t = reuleaux w (t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) := fun t => by
    have h := reuleaux_period_shift w k (t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
    rwa [show t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) = t from by ring] at h
  have hfunEq : reuleaux w =ᶠ[𝓝 (-(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))]
      (fun t => reuleaux w (t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfun
  apply hfunEq.hasDerivAt_iff.mpr
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) 1
      (-(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id _).sub (hasDerivAt_const _ _)).congr_deriv (by ring)
  
  have hneg_pi6 : HasDerivAt (reuleaux w) ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6))
      ((fun t => t - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) (-(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) := by
    simp only [show -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) =
        -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring]
    
    have hd_arc : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ + Real.pi / 3))
        ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (-(Real.pi / 6)) := by
      have hadd : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ + Real.pi / 3) 1 (-(Real.pi / 6)) :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id _).add (hasDerivAt_const _ _)).congr_deriv (by ring)
      have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos _).comp _ hadd
      have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_const _ w).sub (h2.const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)))
      exact h3.congr_deriv (by
        simp only [mul_one]
        rw [show -(Real.pi / 6) + Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 6 from by ring]; ring)
    
    have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ)
        ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (-(Real.pi / 6)) :=
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos (-(Real.pi / 6))).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)).congr_deriv (by
        rw [Real.sin_neg]; ring)
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_left_right]
    constructor
    · 
      apply (hd_arc.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsLT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
      apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (show -(Real.pi / 2) < -(Real.pi / 6) by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
      intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
      have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ + 2 * Real.pi / 3 := by
        rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩,
               -1, by push_cast; ring⟩
      have hmodneg : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (-(Real.pi / 6)) = -(Real.pi / 6) := by
        rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; exact ⟨le_refl _, by linarith [Real.pi_pos, reuleaux_period_pos]⟩
      
      have hθ : reuleaux w θ = w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ + Real.pi / 3) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]
        rw [if_neg (by linarith)]
        congr 1; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      
      have h6 : reuleaux w (-(Real.pi / 6)) = w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (-(Real.pi / 6) + Real.pi / 3) := by
        have hcosval : reuleaux w (-(Real.pi / 6)) = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (-(Real.pi / 6)) := by
          simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmodneg]; rw [if_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]
        rw [hcosval, show -(Real.pi / 6) + Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 6 from by ring,
            Real.cos_neg, Real.cos_pi_div_six]
        have hsq : Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sqrt 3 = 3 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
        field_simp; nlinarith
      simp only [slope, hθ, h6]
    · 
      apply (hd_cos.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
      apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show -(Real.pi / 6) < Real.pi / 6 by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
      intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
      have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ := by
        rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩
      have hmodneg : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) (-(Real.pi / 6)) = -(Real.pi / 6) := by
        rw [toIcoMod_eq_self]; exact ⟨le_refl _, by linarith [Real.pi_pos, reuleaux_period_pos]⟩
      have hθ : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_pos (by linarith)]
      have h6 : reuleaux w (-(Real.pi / 6)) = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (-(Real.pi / 6)) := by
        simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmodneg]; rw [if_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]
      simp only [slope, hθ, h6]
  exact (hneg_pi6.comp (-(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) h1).congr_deriv (mul_one _)

name: Barbier.reuleaux_smooth'
statement: private lemma reuleaux_smooth' (w : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (reuleaux w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
  have toIco_k : ∀ (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ),
      -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ →
      θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) →
      toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    intro k θ hlo hhi
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k, by simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring⟩
  constructor
  · 
    intro θ
    set p := toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    have hp_range := toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, θ = p + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
      use toIcoDiv reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
      have h := toIcoMod_add_toIcoDiv_zsmul reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
      simp only [zsmul_eq_mul] at h; linarith
    rcases lt_trichotomy p (-(Real.pi / 6)) with h_neg | h_neg_eq | h_pos
    · 
      exact absurd h_neg (not_lt.mpr hp_range.1)
    · 
      rw [hk, h_neg_eq]
      exact (hasDerivAt_reuleaux_neg_pi6_kbreak w k).differentiableAt
    · rcases lt_or_ge p (Real.pi / 6) with hlt | hge
      · 
        have hlocal : reuleaux w =ᶠ[𝓝 θ]
            (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem
            (show Ioo (-(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
                (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) ∈ 𝓝 θ from
              Ioo_mem_nhds (by rw [hk]; linarith) (by rw [hk]; linarith))
            fun θ' hθ' => by
              have hmod := toIco_k k θ' hθ'.1 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hθ'.2])
              simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_pos (by linarith [hθ'.2])]
        exact (Filter.EventuallyEq.differentiableAt_iff hlocal).mpr (by fun_prop)
      · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hge with heq | hgt
        · 
          rw [hk, ← heq]
          exact (hasDerivAt_reuleaux_kbreak w k).differentiableAt
        · 
          have hhi_θ : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
            rw [hk]; linarith [hp_range.2, show -(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 2 from by ring]
          have hlocal : reuleaux w =ᶠ[𝓝 θ]
              (fun θ' => w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) :=
            Filter.eventually_of_mem
              (show Ioo (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
                  (Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) ∈ 𝓝 θ from
                Ioo_mem_nhds (by rw [hk]; linarith) hhi_θ)
              fun θ' hθ' => by
                have hmod := toIco_k k θ' (by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hθ'.1]) (by linarith [hθ'.2])
                simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_neg (by linarith [hθ'.1])]
          exact (Filter.EventuallyEq.differentiableAt_iff hlocal).mpr (by fun_prop)
  · 
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro θ
    set p := toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    have hp_range := toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, θ = p + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
      use toIcoDiv reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
      have h := toIcoMod_add_toIcoDiv_zsmul reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
      simp only [zsmul_eq_mul] at h; linarith
    have hhi_θ : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
      rw [hk]; linarith [hp_range.2, show -(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 2 from by ring]
    rcases lt_trichotomy p (-(Real.pi / 6)) with h_neg | h_neg_eq | h_pos
    · exact absurd h_neg (not_lt.mpr hp_range.1)
    · 
      have hθ_eq : θ = -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by rw [hk, h_neg_eq]
      subst hθ_eq
      set θ0 := -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)
      rw [continuousAt_iff_continuous_left_right]
      have hval : deriv (reuleaux w) θ0 = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) :=
        (hasDerivAt_reuleaux_neg_pi6_kbreak w k).deriv
      constructor
      · 
        show Filter.Tendsto (deriv (reuleaux w)) (nhdsWithin θ0 (Iic θ0)) (nhds (deriv (reuleaux w) θ0))
        rw [hval]
        have hev : (λ θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3))
            =ᶠ[nhdsWithin θ0 (Iic θ0)] deriv (reuleaux w) := by
          apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
            (Ioc_mem_nhdsLE (show θ0 - Real.pi / 3 < θ0 by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
          intro θ' ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hhi' with rfl | hlt'
          · rw [hval]; push_cast
            congr 1; congr 1
            simp only [θ0]; push_cast; ring
          · have hlo_k1 : Real.pi / 6 + ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ' := by
              push_cast; simp only [θ0] at hlo'; push_cast at hlo'; linarith
            have hhi_k1 : θ' < Real.pi / 2 + ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
              push_cast; simp only [θ0] at hlt'; push_cast at hlt'; linarith [Real.pi_pos]
            exact (deriv_reuleaux_arc_eq'' w (k - 1) θ' hlo_k1 hhi_k1).symm
        have hcont : ContinuousAt
            (λ θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) θ0 :=
          by fun_prop
        have heq2 : (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ0 - ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3) =
            (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) := by
          push_cast; congr 1; congr 1
          simp only [θ0]; push_cast; ring
        exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' hev (heq2 ▸ hcont.continuousWithinAt)
      · 
        show Filter.Tendsto (deriv (reuleaux w)) (nhdsWithin θ0 (Ici θ0)) (nhds (deriv (reuleaux w) θ0))
        rw [hval]
        have hev : (λ θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)))
            =ᶠ[nhdsWithin θ0 (Ici θ0)] deriv (reuleaux w) := by
          apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
            (Ico_mem_nhdsGE (show θ0 < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) by
              simp only [θ0]; linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
          intro θ' ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlo' with rfl | hlt'
          · rw [hval]
            simp only [θ0]
            rw [show -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) =
                -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring
          · exact (deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq'' w k θ' (by
              simp only [θ0] at hlt' ⊢; linarith) hhi').symm
        have hcont : ContinuousAt
            (λ θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) θ0 := by fun_prop
        have heq2 : -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ0 - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) =
            (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) := by
          simp only [θ0]
          rw [show -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) =
              -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring
        exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' hev (heq2 ▸ hcont.continuousWithinAt)
    · rcases lt_or_ge p (Real.pi / 6) with hlt | hge
      · 
        have hlocal : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[𝓝 θ]
            (fun θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem
            (show Ioo (-(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
                (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) ∈ 𝓝 θ from
              Ioo_mem_nhds (by rw [hk]; linarith) (by rw [hk]; linarith))
            fun θ' hθ' => deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq'' w k θ' hθ'.1 hθ'.2
        exact ContinuousAt.congr (by fun_prop : ContinuousAt
            (fun θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) θ) hlocal.symm
      · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hge with heq | hgt
        · 
          have hθ_eq : θ = Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by rw [hk, ← heq]
          subst hθ_eq
          set θ0 := Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)
          rw [continuousAt_iff_continuous_left_right]
          have hval : deriv (reuleaux w) θ0 = -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) :=
            (hasDerivAt_reuleaux_kbreak w k).deriv
          constructor
          · 
            show Filter.Tendsto (deriv (reuleaux w)) (nhdsWithin θ0 (Iic θ0))
                (nhds (deriv (reuleaux w) θ0))
            rw [hval]
            have hev : (λ θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)))
                =ᶠ[nhdsWithin θ0 (Iic θ0)] deriv (reuleaux w) := by
              apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
                (Ioc_mem_nhdsLE (show -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ0 by
                  simp only [θ0]; linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
              intro θ' ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
              rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hhi' with rfl | hlt'
              · rw [hval]; simp only [θ0]; congr 1; congr 1; ring
              · exact (deriv_reuleaux_cos_eq'' w k θ' (by
                  have : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ0 := by
                    simp only [θ0]; linarith [Real.pi_pos]
                  linarith) hlt').symm
            have hcont : ContinuousAt
                (λ θ' => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))) θ0 :=
              by fun_prop
            have heq2 : -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ0 - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) =
                -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) := by
              simp only [θ0]; congr 1; congr 1; ring
            exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' hev (heq2 ▸ hcont.continuousWithinAt)
          · 
            show Filter.Tendsto (deriv (reuleaux w)) (nhdsWithin θ0 (Ici θ0))
                (nhds (deriv (reuleaux w) θ0))
            rw [hval]
            have hev : (λ θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3))
                =ᶠ[nhdsWithin θ0 (Ici θ0)] deriv (reuleaux w) := by
              apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
                (Ico_mem_nhdsGE (show θ0 < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) by
                  simp only [θ0]; linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
              intro θ' ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩
              rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlo' with rfl | hlt'
              · rw [hval]
                have heq3' : (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ0 - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3) =
                    -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) := by
                  simp only [θ0]
                  rw [show Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3 =
                      -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring
                exact heq3'
              · exact (deriv_reuleaux_arc_eq'' w k θ' hlt' hhi').symm
            have hcont : ContinuousAt
                (λ θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) θ0 :=
              by fun_prop
            have heq3 : (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ0 - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3) =
                -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) := by
              simp only [θ0]
              rw [show Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3 =
                  -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring
            exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' hev (heq3 ▸ hcont.continuousWithinAt)

        · 
          have hlocal : deriv (reuleaux w) =ᶠ[𝓝 θ]
              (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) :=
            Filter.eventually_of_mem
              (show Ioo (Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3))
                  (Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) ∈ 𝓝 θ from
                Ioo_mem_nhds (by rw [hk]; linarith) hhi_θ)
              fun θ' hθ' => deriv_reuleaux_arc_eq'' w k θ' hθ'.1 hθ'.2
          exact ContinuousAt.congr (by fun_prop : ContinuousAt
              (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) - Real.pi / 3)) θ) hlocal.symm

name: Barbier.reuleaux_hphdd_cos''
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_hphdd_cos'' (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hlo : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ)
    (hhi : θ < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) :
    reuleaux w θ + deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmod := toIcoMod_k_int' k θ hlo (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hval : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)) := by
    simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_pos (by linarith)]
  rw [hval, dderiv_reuleaux_cos'' w k θ hlo hhi]; ring

name: Barbier.reuleaux_hphdd_arc''

name: Barbier.reuleaux_breaks_countable'

:=

name: Barbier.reuleaux_breaks_field'
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_breaks_field' (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) :
    ∀ θ ∉ reuleaux_breaks',
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ ∧
      0 ≤ reuleaux w θ + deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ
proof:
:= by
  intro θ hθ
  set p := toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ with hp_def
  have hp_range : p ∈ Set.Ico (-(Real.pi / 6)) (-(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3) :=
    toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, θ = p + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    use toIcoDiv reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    have h := toIcoMod_add_toIcoDiv_zsmul reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul] at h; linarith
  have hp_ne : p ≠ Real.pi / 6 := by
    intro heq; apply hθ
    simp only [reuleaux_breaks', Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact Or.inl ⟨k, by rw [hk, heq]⟩
  have hp_lo_ne : p ≠ -(Real.pi / 6) := by
    intro heq; apply hθ
    simp only [reuleaux_breaks', Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact Or.inr ⟨k, by rw [hk, heq]⟩
  have hp_lo : -(Real.pi / 6) < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp_range.1 (Ne.symm hp_lo_ne)
  have hlo_θ : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ := by rw [hk]; linarith
  have hhi_θ : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    rw [hk]; linarith [hp_range.2, show -(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 2 from by ring]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hp_ne with hlt | hgt
  · have hhi : θ < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by rw [hk]; linarith
    refine ⟨differentiableAt_deriv_reuleaux_cos'' w k θ hlo_θ hhi, ?_⟩
    rw [reuleaux_hphdd_cos'' w k θ hlo_θ hhi]
  · have hlo : Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ := by rw [hk]; linarith
    refine ⟨differentiableAt_deriv_reuleaux_arc'' w k θ hlo hhi_θ, ?_⟩
    rw [reuleaux_hphdd_arc'' w k θ hlo hhi_θ]; exact hw.le

name: Barbier.measurable_toIcoMod_reuleaux
statement:
private lemma measurable_toIcoMod_reuleaux :
    Measurable (toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)))
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousOn.measurable_of_countable_compl
    (s := {x | ¬x ≡ -(Real.pi / 6) [PMOD (2 * Real.pi / 3)]})
  · intro x hx
    exact (continuousAt_toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos _ hx).continuousWithinAt
  · have hsub : {x : ℝ | x ≡ -(Real.pi / 6) [PMOD (2 * Real.pi / 3)]} ⊆
        ⋃ (n : ℤ), ({-(Real.pi / 6) + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)} : Set ℝ) := by
      intro x (heq : x ≡ -(Real.pi / 6) [PMOD (2 * Real.pi / 3)])
      rw [modEq_iff_zsmul] at heq
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := heq; simp only [zsmul_eq_mul] at hm
      have hx : x = -(Real.pi / 6) + (-m : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by push_cast; linarith
      rw [hx]; exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem (-m) (Set.mem_singleton _)
    apply (Set.countable_iUnion (fun (n : ℤ) => Set.countable_singleton _)).mono
    calc {x | ¬x ≡ -(Real.pi / 6) [PMOD (2 * Real.pi / 3)]}ᶜ
        = {x | x ≡ -(Real.pi / 6) [PMOD (2 * Real.pi / 3)]} := by ext x; simp
      _ ⊆ ⋃ (n : ℤ), ({-(Real.pi / 6) + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3)} : Set ℝ) := hsub

name: Barbier.measurable_reuleaux
statement: private lemma measurable_reuleaux (w : ℝ) : Measurable (reuleaux w)
proof:
:= by
