    unfold reuleauxPiece
    exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic
      (measurable_const.mul Real.measurable_cos)
      (measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul
        (Real.measurable_cos.comp (measurable_id.sub measurable_const))))
  exact h1.comp measurable_toIcoMod_reuleaux

name: Barbier.reuleaux_hphdd_bound_nbp
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_hphdd_bound_nbp (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∉ reuleaux_breaks') :
    |reuleaux w θ + deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ| ≤ 2 * w
proof:
:= by
  set p := toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
  have hp_range := toIcoMod_mem_Ico reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, θ = p + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    use toIcoDiv reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    have h := toIcoMod_add_toIcoDiv_zsmul reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul] at h; linarith
  have hp_ne : p ≠ Real.pi / 6 := by
    intro heq; apply hθ
    simp only [reuleaux_breaks', Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact Or.inl ⟨k, by rw [hk, heq]⟩
  have hp_lo_ne : p ≠ -(Real.pi / 6) := by
    intro heq; apply hθ
    simp only [reuleaux_breaks', Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact Or.inr ⟨k, by rw [hk, heq]⟩
  have hp_lo : -(Real.pi / 6) < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp_range.1 (Ne.symm hp_lo_ne)
  have hlo_θ : -(Real.pi / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ := by rw [hk]; linarith
  have hhi_θ : θ < Real.pi / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by
    rw [hk]; linarith [hp_range.2, show -(Real.pi / 6) + 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 2 from by ring]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hp_ne with hlt | hgt
  · 
    have hhi : θ < Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) := by rw [hk]; linarith
    rw [reuleaux_hphdd_cos'' w k θ hlo_θ hhi, abs_zero]; linarith
  · 
    have hlo : Real.pi / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi / 3) < θ := by rw [hk]; linarith
    rw [reuleaux_hphdd_arc'' w k θ hlo hhi_θ, abs_of_pos hw]; linarith

name: Barbier.reuleaux_integrable'
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_integrable' (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => reuleaux w θ + deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (intervalIntegrable_const (c := 2 * w))
  · apply AEStronglyMeasurable.add
    · exact (measurable_reuleaux w).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (measurable_deriv (deriv (reuleaux w))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · 
    apply ae_restrict_of_ae
    have hbreaks : ∀ᵐ θ ∂volume, θ ∉ reuleaux_breaks' := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_iff, mem_ae_iff]
      have : {x : ℝ | x ∉ reuleaux_breaks'}ᶜ = reuleaux_breaks' := by ext; simp
      rw [this]
      exact reuleaux_breaks_countable'.measure_zero volume
    filter_upwards [hbreaks] with θ hθ
    exact reuleaux_hphdd_bound_nbp w hw θ hθ

name: Barbier.reuleaux_constWidth
statement: theorem reuleaux_constWidth {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) : PiecewiseConstWidth (reuleaux w) w
proof:
:=
  { smooth := reuleaux_smooth' w
    periodic := reuleaux_periodic w
    width := reuleaux_width w
    breaks := ⟨reuleaux_breaks', reuleaux_breaks_countable',
               fun θ hθ => (reuleaux_breaks_field' w hw θ hθ).1,
               fun θ hθ => (reuleaux_breaks_field' w hw θ hθ).2⟩
    integrable := reuleaux_integrable' w hw }

name: Barbier.reuleaux_not_smooth
statement: theorem reuleaux_not_smooth {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) : ¬ ContDiff ℝ 2 (reuleaux w)
proof:
:= by
  intro hC
  have hD : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv (reuleaux w)) := contDiff_one_deriv hC
  have hcont : Continuous (deriv (deriv (reuleaux w))) := hD.continuous_deriv_one
  have hcat : ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv (reuleaux w))) (Real.pi / 6) := hcont.continuousAt
  
  have hleft_eq : ∀ᶠ θ in 𝓝[<] (Real.pi/6),
      deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ = -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT pi6_neg_lt_pi6)
      (fun θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ => dderiv_left hlo hhi w hC)
  
  have hright_eq : ∀ᶠ θ in 𝓝[>] (Real.pi/6),
      deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 3) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT' pi6_lt_pi2)
      (fun θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ => dderiv_right hlo hhi w hC)
  
  have hval_L : -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6) = -w / 2 := by
    rw [Real.cos_pi_div_six]; field_simp
  have hval_R : (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi / 3) = w / 2 := by
    rw [show Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi / 3 = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring,
        Real.cos_neg, Real.cos_pi_div_six]; field_simp
  
  have hg_left : Filter.Tendsto (fun θ => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ)
      (𝓝[<] (Real.pi/6)) (𝓝 (-w / 2)) := by
    rw [← hval_L]
    have hcL : ContinuousAt (fun θ => -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos θ) (Real.pi/6) := by fun_prop
    exact hcL.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hleft : Filter.Tendsto (deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)))
      (𝓝[<] (Real.pi/6)) (𝓝 (-w / 2)) :=
    Tendsto.congr' (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm hleft_eq) hg_left
  
  have hg_right : Filter.Tendsto (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 3))
      (𝓝[>] (Real.pi/6)) (𝓝 (w / 2)) := by
    rw [← hval_R]
    have hcR : ContinuousAt (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 3))
        (Real.pi/6) := by fun_prop
    exact hcR.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hright : Filter.Tendsto (deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)))
      (𝓝[>] (Real.pi/6)) (𝓝 (w / 2)) :=
    Tendsto.congr' (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm hright_eq) hg_right
  
  have hval_left : deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) (Real.pi / 6) = -w / 2 :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique (hcat.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) hleft
  have hval_right : deriv (deriv (reuleaux w)) (Real.pi / 6) = w / 2 :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique (hcat.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) hright
  linarith

name: Barbier.normSq_diff_5pi6
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.exp_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im,
             Complex.mul_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_re,
             Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_im,
             mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, one_mul, add_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
  have hc : Real.cos (5 * Real.pi / 6) = -Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    rw [show 5 * Real.pi / 6 = Real.pi - Real.pi / 6 from by ring,
        Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_six]; ring
  have hs : Real.sin (5 * Real.pi / 6) = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [show 5 * Real.pi / 6 = Real.pi - Real.pi / 6 from by ring,
        Real.sin_pi_sub, Real.sin_pi_div_six]
  rw [hc, hs, Real.cos_pi_div_six, Real.sin_pi_div_six]
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0:ℝ) < 3 by norm_num), sqrt3_sq]

name: Barbier.normSq_diff_7pi6
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.exp_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im,
             Complex.mul_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_re,
             Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_im,
             mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, one_mul, add_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
  have hc : Real.cos (7 * Real.pi / 6) = -Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    rw [show 7 * Real.pi / 6 = Real.pi / 6 + Real.pi from by ring,
        Real.cos_add_pi, Real.cos_pi_div_six]; ring
  have hs : Real.sin (7 * Real.pi / 6) = -(1 / 2) := by
    rw [show 7 * Real.pi / 6 = Real.pi / 6 + Real.pi from by ring,
        Real.sin_add_pi, Real.sin_pi_div_six]
  rw [hc, hs, Real.cos_pi_div_six, Real.sin_pi_div_six]
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0:ℝ) < 3 by norm_num), sqrt3_sq]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_right_piece
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlo with rfl | hlo'
  · rw [reuleaux_5pi6_val, show 5 * Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring,
        Real.cos_neg, Real.cos_pi_div_six]
    field_simp; nlinarith [sqrt3_sq, sqrt3_pos]
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hhi with rfl | hhi'
    · rw [reuleaux_7pi6_val, show 7 * Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi = Real.pi / 6 from by ring,
          Real.cos_pi_div_six]
      field_simp; nlinarith [sqrt3_sq, sqrt3_pos]
    · exact reuleaux_arc_int_val hlo' hhi' w

  · rw [reuleaux_7pi6_val, show 7 * Real.pi / 6 - 4 * Real.pi / 3 = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring,
        Real.cos_neg]
  · simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece]
    have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(Real.pi / 6)) θ = θ - 4 * Real.pi / 3 := by
      rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, 2, by push_cast; ring⟩
    rw [hmod, if_pos (by linarith)]

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_reuleaux_5pi6_val
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_reuleaux_5pi6_val (w : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (reuleaux w) (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (5 * Real.pi / 6)
proof:
:= by
  have hd_left : HasDerivAt (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - 2 * Real.pi / 3))
      (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (5 * Real.pi / 6) := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_cos_sub (2 * Real.pi / 3) (5 * Real.pi / 6)).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)
    exact h.congr_deriv (by
      rw [show 5 * Real.pi / 6 - 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi / 6 from by ring]; ring)
  have hd_right : HasDerivAt (fun θ => w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi))
      (-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (5 * Real.pi / 6) := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_cos_sub Real.pi (5 * Real.pi / 6)).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)
    exact ((hasDerivAt_const _ w).sub h).congr_deriv (by
      rw [show 5 * Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring)
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_left_right]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (hd_left.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsLT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
      (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (show 2 * Real.pi / 3 < 5 * Real.pi / 6 by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    simp only [slope, reuleaux_left_piece (le_of_lt hlo) (le_of_lt hhi),
               reuleaux_left_piece (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) le_rfl]
  · apply (hd_right.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
      (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show 5 * Real.pi / 6 < 7 * Real.pi / 6 by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    simp only [slope, reuleaux_right_piece (le_of_lt hlo) (le_of_lt hhi),
               reuleaux_right_piece le_rfl (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_reuleaux_7pi6_val

private lemma hasDerivAt_reuleaux_7pi6_val (w : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (reuleaux w) ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (7 * Real.pi / 6)

      ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (7 * Real.pi / 6) := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_cos_sub Real.pi (7 * Real.pi / 6)).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)
    exact ((hasDerivAt_const _ w).sub h).congr_deriv (by
      rw [show 7 * Real.pi / 6 - Real.pi = Real.pi / 6 from by ring]; ring)
  have hd_right : HasDerivAt (fun θ => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - 4 * Real.pi / 3))
      ((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) (7 * Real.pi / 6) := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_cos_sub (4 * Real.pi / 3) (7 * Real.pi / 6)).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)
    exact h.congr_deriv (by
      rw [show 7 * Real.pi / 6 - 4 * Real.pi / 3 = -(Real.pi / 6) from by ring, Real.sin_neg]; ring)
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_left_right]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (hd_left.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsLT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
      (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT (show 5 * Real.pi / 6 < 7 * Real.pi / 6 by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    simp only [slope, reuleaux_right_piece (le_of_lt hlo) (le_of_lt hhi),
               reuleaux_right_piece (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) le_rfl]
  · apply (hd_right.tendsto_slope.mono_left (nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE _)).congr'
    apply Filter.eventually_of_mem
      (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show 7 * Real.pi / 6 < 4 * Real.pi / 3 by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
    intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    simp only [slope, reuleaux_right7_piece (le_of_lt hlo) (le_of_lt hhi),
               reuleaux_right7_piece le_rfl (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_arc_formula_val
proof:
:=
  ((hasDerivAt_const θ w).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_cos_sub Real.pi θ).const_mul _)).congr_deriv (by ring)

name: Barbier.reuleaux_locally_eq_arc_int
proof:
:= by
  apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi)
  intro θ ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩; exact reuleaux_arc_int_val hlo' hhi' w

name: Barbier.curve_reuleaux_arc_int
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve, reuleaux_arc_int_val hlo hhi,
      (reuleaux_locally_eq_arc_int hlo hhi w).deriv_eq,
      (hasDerivAt_arc_formula_val w θ₀).deriv]
  push_cast; rw [Complex.exp_mul_I]
  have hcos : Complex.cos (↑θ₀ - ↑Real.pi) = -Complex.cos ↑θ₀ := by
    rw [Complex.cos_sub, Complex.cos_pi, Complex.sin_pi]; ring
  have hsin : Complex.sin (↑θ₀ - ↑Real.pi) = -Complex.sin ↑θ₀ := by
    rw [Complex.sin_sub, Complex.cos_pi, Complex.sin_pi]; ring
  rw [hcos, hsin]
  have hI2 : Complex.I ^ 2 = -1 := Complex.I_sq
  have hcos2 : Complex.cos ↑θ₀ ^ 2 + Complex.sin ↑θ₀ ^ 2 = 1 :=
    Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq ↑θ₀
  have hsin2_eq : Complex.sin ↑θ₀ ^ 2 * Complex.I ^ 2 = -Complex.sin ↑θ₀ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hI2]; ring
  linear_combination (↑w / ↑(Real.sqrt 3)) * hcos2 - (↑w / ↑(Real.sqrt 3)) * hsin2_eq

name: Barbier.w_div_sqrt3_sq_mul3
statement: private lemma w_div_sqrt3_sq_mul3 (w : ℝ) : (w / Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 * 3 = w ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  field_simp; nlinarith [sqrt3_sq, sqrt3_pos]

name: Barbier.dist_arc_int
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_reuleaux_arc_int hlo hhi, curve_reuleaux_zero, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [show (↑w * Complex.exp (↑θ₀ * Complex.I) + ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3)) -
        ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) = ↑w * Complex.exp (↑θ₀ * Complex.I) by push_cast; ring]
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hw,
      Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]

name: Barbier.dist_arc_5pi6
statement:
private lemma dist_arc_5pi6 {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) (5 * Real.pi / 6)) (curve (reuleaux w) 0) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_reuleaux_zero, curve, reuleaux_5pi6_val,
      (hasDerivAt_reuleaux_5pi6_val w).deriv, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [show ((↑(w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6)) +
        ↑(-(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) * Complex.I) *
       Complex.exp (↑(5 * Real.pi / 6) * Complex.I) - ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ)) =
      ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * ((↑(Real.cos (Real.pi / 6)) -
        ↑(Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (↑(5 * Real.pi / 6) * Complex.I) - 1)
    from by push_cast; ring]
  apply norm_eq_of_normSq hw
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_ofReal, normSq_diff_5pi6]
  linarith [w_div_sqrt3_sq_mul3 w]

name: Barbier.dist_arc_7pi6
statement:
private lemma dist_arc_7pi6 {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    dist (curve (reuleaux w) (7 * Real.pi / 6)) (curve (reuleaux w) 0) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_reuleaux_zero, curve, reuleaux_7pi6_val,
      (hasDerivAt_reuleaux_7pi6_val w).deriv, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [show ((↑(w / Real.sqrt 3 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 6)) +
        ↑((w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) * Complex.I) *
       Complex.exp (↑(7 * Real.pi / 6) * Complex.I) - ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ)) =
      ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * ((↑(Real.cos (Real.pi / 6)) +
        ↑(Real.sin (Real.pi / 6)) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (↑(7 * Real.pi / 6) * Complex.I) - 1)
    from by push_cast; ring]
  apply norm_eq_of_normSq hw
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_ofReal, normSq_diff_7pi6]
  linarith [w_div_sqrt3_sq_mul3 w]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_arc
statement:
theorem reuleaux_arc {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (5 * π / 6) (7 * π / 6),
      dist (curve (reuleaux w) θ) (curve (reuleaux w) 0) = w
proof:
:= by
  intro θ hθ
  rcases hθ with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlo with rfl | hlo'
  · exact dist_arc_5pi6 hw
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hhi with rfl | hhi'
  · exact dist_arc_7pi6 hw
  · exact dist_arc_int hlo' hhi' hw

name: Barbier.circle_constWidth
statement:
theorem circle_constWidth (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) : ConstWidthSupport (fun _ => w / 2) w where
  smooth
proof:
:= contDiff_const
  periodic := fun _ => rfl
  width := fun _ => by ring
  convex := fun _ => by simp only [deriv_const']; linarith

name: Barbier.circle_perimeter
statement: theorem circle_perimeter (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) : perimeter (fun _ => w / 2) = π * w
proof:
:=
  barbier (circle_constWidth w hw)

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_trefoil
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_trefoil (a b θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (trefoil a b) (-(3 * b) * Real.sin (3 * θ)) θ
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasDerivAt (trefoil a b) (b * (-Real.sin (3 * θ) * (3 * 1))) θ :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id θ).const_mul 3).cos.const_mul b).const_add a
  exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)

name: Barbier.deriv_trefoil
statement:
lemma deriv_trefoil (a b : ℝ) :
    deriv (trefoil a b) = fun θ => -(3 * b) * Real.sin (3 * θ)
proof:
:=
  funext fun θ => (hasDerivAt_trefoil a b θ).deriv

name: Barbier.deriv_deriv_trefoil
statement:
lemma deriv_deriv_trefoil (a b θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (trefoil a b)) θ = -(9 * b) * Real.cos (3 * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_trefoil]
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun θ => -(3 * b) * Real.sin (3 * θ))
      (-(3 * b) * (Real.cos (3 * θ) * (3 * 1))) θ :=
    (((hasDerivAt_id θ).const_mul 3).sin).const_mul (-(3 * b))
  rw [h.deriv]
  ring

name: Barbier.trefoil_constWidth
statement:
theorem trefoil_constWidth {a b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : 8 * b ≤ a) :
    ConstWidthSupport (trefoil a b) (2 * a) where
  smooth
proof:
:= by unfold trefoil; fun_prop
  periodic := fun θ => by
    unfold trefoil
    rw [show 3 * (θ + 2 * π) = 3 * θ + (3 : ℕ) * (2 * π) by push_cast; ring,
      Real.cos_add_nat_mul_two_pi]
  width := fun θ => by
    unfold trefoil
    rw [show 3 * (θ + π) = 3 * θ + π + 2 * π by ring, Real.cos_add_two_pi, Real.cos_add_pi]
    ring
  convex := fun θ => by
    rw [deriv_deriv_trefoil]
    unfold trefoil
    nlinarith [Real.cos_le_one (3 * θ), Real.neg_one_le_cos (3 * θ)]

name: Barbier.trefoil_perimeter
statement:
theorem trefoil_perimeter {a b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : 8 * b ≤ a) :
    perimeter (trefoil a b) = π * (2 * a)
proof:
:=
  barbier (trefoil_constWidth hb hab)

name: Barbier.trefoil_not_const
statement: theorem trefoil_not_const {a b : ℝ} (hb : b ≠ 0) : trefoil a b 0 ≠ trefoil a b (π / 3)
proof:
:= by
  unfold trefoil
  rw [mul_zero, Real.cos_zero, show 3 * (π / 3) = π by ring, Real.cos_pi]
  intro h
  apply hb
  linarith

name: Barbier.hasDerivAt_cos_sub'
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_cos_sub' (c θ₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.cos (θ - c)) (-Real.sin (θ₀ - c)) θ₀
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ => θ - c) 1 θ₀ :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id θ₀).sub (hasDerivAt_const θ₀ c)).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (θ₀ - c)).comp θ₀ h1
  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: Barbier.exp_neg_mul_I
statement:
private lemma exp_neg_mul_I (α : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp (-(↑α * I)) = ↑(Real.cos α) - ↑(Real.sin α) * I
proof:
:= by
  rw [show -(↑α * I : ℂ) = ↑(-α) * I by push_cast; ring, Complex.exp_mul_I]
  push_cast; simp [Complex.cos_neg, Complex.sin_neg]; ring

name: Barbier.continuous_curve_reuleaux
statement:
private lemma continuous_curve_reuleaux {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    Continuous (curve (reuleaux w))
proof:
:= by
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 (reuleaux w) := (reuleaux_constWidth hw).smooth
  show Continuous (fun θ => ((reuleaux w θ : ℂ) + ((deriv (reuleaux w) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) *
      Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * I))
  apply Continuous.mul
  · apply Continuous.add
    · exact Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp hsmooth.continuous
    · exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp hsmooth.continuous_deriv_one).mul continuous_const
  · exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp continuous_id |>.mul continuous_const).cexp

name: Barbier.corner_eqOn_Ioo
statement:
private lemma corner_eqOn_Ioo (w : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    EqOn (curve (reuleaux w))
      (fun _ => ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * exp (↑((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) * I))
      (Set.Ioo (-(π / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) (π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  have hmod : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) θ = θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) := by
    rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k,
           by simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring⟩
  have hval : reuleaux w θ = (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) := by
    simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod]; rw [if_pos]; linarith
  have hev : reuleaux w =ᶠ[nhds θ]
      (fun θ' => (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi) fun θ' ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩ => by
      have hmod' : toIcoMod reuleaux_period_pos (-(π / 6)) θ' = θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) := by
        rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k,
               by simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring⟩
      simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, hmod']; rw [if_pos]; linarith
  have hder : deriv (reuleaux w) θ = -(w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) := by
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    have hd := (hasDerivAt_cos_sub' ((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) θ).const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)
    rw [hd.deriv]; ring
  simp only [curve, hval, hder]
  set α := θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)
  set β := (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)
  have hθ : θ = α + β := by simp [α, β]
  have hkey : (Complex.cos ↑α - Complex.sin ↑α * I) * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) =
      Complex.exp (I * ↑β) := by
    rw [show Complex.cos ↑α - Complex.sin ↑α * I = Complex.exp (-(↑α * I)) from by
      rw [exp_neg_mul_I]; push_cast; ring]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast [hθ]; ring
  push_cast
  ring_nf
  rw [show ↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹ * Complex.cos ↑α * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) -
      ↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹ * Complex.sin ↑α * I * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) =
      ↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹ * ((Complex.cos ↑α - Complex.sin ↑α * I) * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ)) by ring]
  rw [hkey]

name: Barbier.corner_eqOn_Icc
statement:
private lemma corner_eqOn_Icc {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (k : ℤ) :
    EqOn (curve (reuleaux w))
      (fun _ => ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * exp (↑((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) * I))
      (Set.Icc (-(π / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) (π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)))
proof:
:=
  (corner_eqOn_Ioo w k).of_subset_closure
    (continuous_curve_reuleaux hw).continuousOn continuousOn_const
    Ioo_subset_Icc_self
    (by rw [closure_Ioo (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : -(π / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) ≠
        π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))])

name: Barbier.eVariationOn_corner_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [eVariationOn.congr (corner_eqOn_Icc hw k)]
  apply eVariationOn.constant_on
  rw [(Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] :
      -(π / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) ≤ π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))).image_const]
  exact Set.subsingleton_singleton

name: Barbier.arc_toIcoMod
proof:
:= by
  rw [toIcoMod_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩, k, by simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: Barbier.reuleaux_arc_val
statement:
private lemma reuleaux_arc_val {k : ℤ} {θ : ℝ}
    (hlo : π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) < θ) (hhi : θ < π / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))
    (w : ℝ) :
    reuleaux w θ = w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reuleaux, reuleauxPiece, arc_toIcoMod hlo hhi]
  rw [if_neg (by linarith)]

name: Barbier.arc_eqOn_Ioo
statement:
private lemma arc_eqOn_Ioo {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (k : ℤ) :
    EqOn (curve (reuleaux w))
      (fun θ => ↑w * exp (↑θ * I) - ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * exp (↑((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3) * I))
      (Set.Ioo (π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) (π / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  intro θ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  have hev : reuleaux w =ᶠ[nhds θ]
      (fun θ' => w - (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.cos (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3)) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hlo hhi) fun θ' ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩ =>
      reuleaux_arc_val hlo' hhi' w
  have hval := reuleaux_arc_val hlo hhi w
  have hderiv : deriv (reuleaux w) θ =
      (w / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sin (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3) := by
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun θ' => Real.cos (θ' - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3))
        (-Real.sin (θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3)) θ := by
      have h := (hasDerivAt_cos_sub' ((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3) θ)
      simp only [show ∀ x : ℝ, x - ((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3) =
          x - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3 from fun x => by ring] at h
      exact h
    have hd := ((hasDerivAt_const θ w).sub (h1.const_mul (w / Real.sqrt 3)))
    refine hd.congr_deriv ?_ |>.deriv
    ring
  simp only [curve, hval, hderiv]
  set φ := θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) - π / 3
  set c := (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3
  have hθ : θ = φ + c := by simp [φ, c]
  push_cast; ring_nf
  
  rw [show -(↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹ * Complex.cos ↑φ * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ)) +
      ↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹ * Complex.sin ↑φ * I * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) +
      ↑w * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) =
      ↑w * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) + -(↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹) *
      (Complex.cos ↑φ - Complex.sin ↑φ * I) * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) by ring]
  rw [show Complex.cos ↑φ - Complex.sin ↑φ * I = Complex.exp (-(↑φ * I)) from by
    rw [exp_neg_mul_I]; push_cast; ring]
  rw [show -(↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹) * Complex.exp (-(↑φ * I)) * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ) =
      -(↑w * (↑(Real.sqrt 3))⁻¹) * (Complex.exp (-(↑φ * I)) * Complex.exp (I * ↑θ)) by ring]
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  rw [show -(↑φ * I) + I * ↑θ = I * ↑c by push_cast [hθ]; ring]
  ring

name: Barbier.arc_eqOn_Icc
statement:
private lemma arc_eqOn_Icc {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (k : ℤ) :
    EqOn (curve (reuleaux w))
      (fun θ => ↑w * exp (↑θ * I) - ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * exp (↑((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3) * I))
      (Set.Icc (π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) (π / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)))
proof:
:=
  (arc_eqOn_Ioo hw k).of_subset_closure
    (continuous_curve_reuleaux hw).continuousOn
    (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop))
    Ioo_subset_Icc_self
    (by rw [closure_Ioo (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) ≠
        π / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))])

name: Barbier.eVariationOn_arc_piece
statement:
private lemma eVariationOn_arc_piece {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (k : ℤ) :
    eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w))
      (Set.Icc (π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) (π / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (w * (π / 3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eVariationOn.congr (arc_eqOn_Icc hw k)]
  have hfun : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun θ : ℝ =>
      (w : ℂ) * exp (↑θ * I) - ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * exp (↑((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3) * I)) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul ((Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp contDiff_id).mul
        contDiff_const |>.cexp)).sub contDiff_const
  have hab : π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) ≤ π / 2 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) := by
    linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (eVariationOn_ne_top_of_contDiff hfun hab),
    (length_eq_integral_norm_deriv hfun hab).2]
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv (fun θ : ℝ =>
      (w : ℂ) * exp (↑θ * I) -
      ↑(w / Real.sqrt 3) * exp (↑((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3) * I)) t =
      (w : ℂ) * I * exp (↑t * I) := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * I) I t := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).ofReal_comp).mul_const I
      simp at this; exact this
    have h2 := Complex.hasDerivAt_exp ((t : ℂ) * I)
    have hexp : HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * I))
        (Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * I) * I) t := (h2.comp t h1).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have hconst : HasDerivAt
        (fun _ : ℝ => (w / Real.sqrt 3 : ℝ) * Complex.exp (((k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3) + π / 3 : ℝ) * I))
        0 t := hasDerivAt_const t _
    exact ((hexp.const_mul (w : ℂ)).sub hconst).congr_deriv (by ring) |>.deriv
  simp_rw [hderiv]
  simp only [Complex.norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hw,
    Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
  ring_nf

name: Barbier.eVariationOn_corner_subset_zero
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt a b with hab | hab
  · have hle : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc a b) ≤ 0 := by
      calc eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc a b)
          ≤ eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w))
              (Set.Icc (-(π / 6) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3)) (π / 6 + (k : ℝ) * (2 * π / 3))) :=
            eVariationOn.mono _ (Set.Icc_subset_Icc ha hb)
        _ = 0 := eVariationOn_corner_zero hw k
    exact le_zero_iff.mp hle
  · simp [Set.Icc_eq_empty (not_le.mpr hab)]

name: Barbier.segPts_mono
statement: private lemma segPts_mono : Monotone segPts
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro n
  match n with
  | 0 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | 1 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | 2 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | 3 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | 4 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | 5 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | 6 => simp [segPts]; linarith
  | (n + 7) => simp [segPts]

name: Barbier.reuleaux_length
statement:
theorem reuleaux_length {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) = ENNReal.ofReal (π * w)
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 7,
      eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts i) (segPts (i + 1))) =
      eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) := by
    have h0 : segPts 0 = 0 := by simp [segPts]
    have h7 : segPts 7 = 2 * π := by simp [segPts]
    rw [← h0, ← h7]
    exact eVariationOn.sum' (curve (reuleaux w)) segPts_mono (n := 7)
  rw [← hsum]
  have p0 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 0) (segPts 1)) = 0 := by
    simp only [segPts]
    exact eVariationOn_corner_subset_zero hw 0 (by norm_num; linarith) (by norm_num)
  have p1 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 1) (segPts 2)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (w * (π / 3)) := by
    simp only [segPts]
    convert eVariationOn_arc_piece hw 0 using 2
    norm_num
  have p2 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 2) (segPts 3)) = 0 := by
    simp only [segPts]
    convert eVariationOn_corner_zero hw 1 using 2
    simp [Int.cast_one]; ring
  have p3 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 3) (segPts 4)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (w * (π / 3)) := by
    simp only [segPts]
    convert eVariationOn_arc_piece hw 1 using 2
    simp [Int.cast_one]; ring
  have p4 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 4) (segPts 5)) = 0 := by
    simp only [segPts]
    convert eVariationOn_corner_zero hw 2 using 2
    push_cast; ring
  have p5 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 5) (segPts 6)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (w * (π / 3)) := by
    simp only [segPts]
    convert eVariationOn_arc_piece hw 2 using 2
    push_cast; ring
  have p6 : eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc (segPts 6) (segPts 7)) = 0 := by
    simp only [segPts]
    exact eVariationOn_corner_subset_zero hw 3 (by push_cast; linarith) (by push_cast; linarith)
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  rw [p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6]
  simp only [zero_add, add_zero]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  congr 1; linarith

name: Barbier.reuleaux_length_ne_top
statement:
theorem reuleaux_length_ne_top {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π)) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [reuleaux_length hw]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

name: Barbier.reuleaux_perimeter_eq_eVariationOn
statement:
theorem reuleaux_perimeter_eq_eVariationOn {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    perimeter (reuleaux w) = (eVariationOn (curve (reuleaux w)) (Set.Icc 0 (2 * π))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [reuleaux_length hw, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), reuleaux_perimeter hw]
